items.title: 鑫創電子新專案數量暴增5倍 三大核心市場布局擴大
items.title_en: Xinchang Electronics' New Project Volume Surges Fivefold, Expanding Its Three Core Market Deployments
paras: 鑫創電子(6680-TW)表示，隨著全球國防自主化、智慧交通及工業自動化加速導入邊緣AI，公司積極擴大三大核心市場布局，今年新專案與新產品開案量已突破去年同期5倍，市場拓展與產品開發動能持續升溫。
鑫創電子董事長許育瑞指出，AI應用正從概念驗證走向實際部署，帶動軍工、智慧交通及工業自動化市場對高可靠性邊緣AI平台的需求。其中，軍工無人載具、自動駕駛及工業機器人等自主系統，須在通訊受限、極端環境及即時決策等條件下運作，對運算效能、散熱能力及系統可靠性提出更高要求。
在軍工市場方面，許育瑞表示，強固型邊緣AI平台已應用於國際國防系統整合商的無人地面載具專案，支援自主導航、多感測器融合及運動控制，協助提升自主系統在複雜環境中的運作效率與可靠性。隨著全球國防科技朝無人化與自主化發展，無人地面載具(UGV)、自主偵察平台及軍用機器人等應用，持續帶動相關運算需求。
除軍工應用外，鑫創電子也拓展智慧交通與工業自動化市場，鎖定自動駕駛、智慧軌道運輸、機器視覺及自主移動機器人(AMR)等應用，並透過技術創新與國際系統整合商合作，推動新專案設計導入，加速後續量產商機轉化，藉由新產品開發及專案導入，推升後續業務成長動能。
paras_en: Xinchang Electronics (6680‑TW) said that as global defense autonomy, smart transportation, and industrial automation accelerate the adoption of edge AI, the company is actively expanding its three core market deployments. This year, the number of new projects and new product launches has already exceeded the same period last year by five times, with market expansion and product development momentum continuing to heat up.

Chairman Hsu Yu‑Jui noted that AI applications are moving from proof‑of‑concept to actual deployment, driving demand for high‑reliability edge AI platforms in the defense, smart transportation, and industrial automation markets. In particular, autonomous systems such as military unmanned vehicles, autonomous driving, and industrial robots must operate under limited communications, extreme environments, and real‑time decision‑making, imposing higher requirements on computing performance, thermal management, and system reliability.

Regarding the defense market, Hsu said that rugged edge AI platforms have already been applied to unmanned ground vehicle projects for international defense system integrators, supporting autonomous navigation, multi‑sensor fusion, and motion control, and helping improve the efficiency and reliability of autonomous systems in complex environments. As global defense technology trends toward unmanned and autonomous solutions, applications such as unmanned ground vehicles (UGV), autonomous reconnaissance platforms, and military robots continue to drive related computing demand.

Beyond defense, Xinchang Electronics is also expanding into smart transportation and industrial automation, targeting applications such as autonomous driving, smart rail transport, machine vision, and autonomous mobile robots (AMR). Through technological innovation and cooperation with international system integrators, the company is promoting new project design adoption, accelerating the conversion of subsequent mass‑production opportunities, and boosting future business growth through new product development and project implementation.

items.title: 結合12吋混合鍵合技術 長鑫存儲加速高階記憶體與3D DRAM布局
items.title_en: Combining 12‑inch Hybrid Bonding Technology, ChangXin Storage Accelerates High‑End Memory and 3D DRAM Layout
paras: 中國半導體記憶體業者長鑫存儲(長鑫科技)宣布在 4F² DRAM 架構設計上取得技術進展，並規劃於 2026 年底前推出新一代 DDR5 RDIMM 伺服器記憶體。此項技術進程反映出該公司在傳統二維平面架構漸趨物理極限之際，轉向三維架構領域發展的戰略轉折。

4F² 垂直架構與混合鍵合之技術機制

據報導，在 DRAM 技術演進中，主流市場長期採用 6F² 結構，但微縮製程已接近電容物理極限。長鑫存儲採用的 4F² 垂直包圍閘(VSG)架構，將電晶體溝道改為垂直排列，使單一記憶體儲存單元面積縮減約三分之一，在相同晶圓面積下，儲存密度可提升 30% 至 50%。
在製造工藝方面，該架構結合 12 吋晶圓級混合鍵合(Hybrid Bonding)技術，將外圍邏輯電路(CMOS)與儲存單元陣列拆開製造後進行三維整合。這種設計解耦策略使廠商得以透過底層結構創新與三維工程技術提升晶片密度與效能，從而降低對極紫外光(EUV)微影設備的單一依賴。

市場供需調整與財務表現

全球 DRAM 市場於 2025 年至 2026 年間出現顯著供需結構變化。由於全球主要記憶體製造商將先進晶圓產能優先調配至高頻寬記憶體(HBM)與高階 DDR5，HBM 所消耗之晶圓量約為傳統 DRAM 的 3 倍。
在主要廠商逐步減少 DDR4 供應的情況下，成熟製程記憶體出現供需缺口，DDR4 單顆現貨價格由 2025 年 11 月的約 12 美元升至 2026 年 10 月的 46.321 美元。
受惠於市場供需調整與產能爬坡，長鑫存儲的財務數據顯著成長。2025 年該公司全年營收為 617.99 億元人民幣，歸母淨利潤為 18.75 億元人民幣；2026 年上半年營收達 1,503.10 億元人民幣，歸母淨利潤為 776.05 億元人民幣，主營業務毛利率為 84.84%。
最新業績預告顯示，其 2026 年前三季預計營收將達 2,650 億至 2,700 億元人民幣，預計歸母淨利潤為 1,310 億至 1,325 億元人民幣。
在市場份額方面，2026 年第二季全球 DRAM 銷售收入創下歷史新高，長鑫存儲以 145.45 億美元營收取得 9.9% 之全球市占率，次於三星(40.2%)、SK 海力士(26.1%)與美光(21.3%)。其月產能規劃預計於 2026 年底突破 30 萬片，並朝長期 60 萬片以上的規模推進。

產品定位與專利布局

長鑫科技總裁曹堪宇日前公開表示，公司規劃首款 4F² 產品為伺服器 DDR5 RDIMM，預計於年底前送交客戶進行驗證。
針對長鑫存儲的市場布局，該公司將首代 4F² 架構直接應用於對穩定性與容錯率要求嚴格的企業級伺服器市場，並搭配已發布的 LPDDR6 移動端儲存產品，顯示其正加速進入高毛利的高階記憶體市場。
paras_en: China's semiconductor memory company ChangXin Storage (ChangXin Technology) announced a technical breakthrough in its 4F² DRAM architecture design and plans to launch a new generation DDR5 RDIMM server memory by the end of 2026. This progress reflects a strategic shift from the increasingly physical limits of traditional two‑dimensional planar architectures toward three‑dimensional designs.

4F² Vertical Architecture and Hybrid Bonding Mechanism
According to reports, the mainstream market has long used a 6F² structure for DRAM, but scaling is approaching the physical limits of the capacitor. ChangXin Storage’s 4F² vertical surround‑gate (VSG) architecture reorients the transistor channel vertically, reducing the area of a single memory cell by roughly one‑third and boosting storage density by 30%‑50% on the same wafer area.

In terms of manufacturing, the architecture integrates 12‑inch wafer‑level hybrid bonding technology, separating the peripheral CMOS logic circuits from the memory cell array for three‑dimensional integration after separate fabrication. This decoupling strategy allows the company to increase chip density and performance through substrate innovation and 3D engineering, thereby reducing reliance on extreme‑ultraviolet (EUV) lithography equipment.

Market supply‑demand adjustments and financial performance
The global DRAM market experienced a significant supply‑demand shift between 2025 and 2026. Major memory manufacturers prioritized advanced wafer capacity for high‑bandwidth memory (HBM) and high‑end DDR5, with HBM consuming roughly three times the wafers used for traditional DRAM.
As leading vendors gradually cut DDR4 supply, a gap emerged for mature‑process memory, pushing the spot price of a single DDR4 module from about $12 in November 2025 to $46.321 in October 2026.

Benefiting from the market adjustment and capacity ramp‑up, ChangXin Storage’s financial figures grew sharply. In 2025 the company posted total revenue of RMB 61.799 billion and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 1.875 billion; in the first half of 2026 revenue reached RMB 150.310 billion with net profit of RMB 77.605 billion and an operating gross margin of 84.84%.
The latest earnings outlook projects 2026 revenue for the first three quarters at RMB 265‑270 billion, with net profit attributable to shareholders estimated at RMB 131‑132.5 billion.

Regarding market share, global DRAM sales revenue hit a historic high in Q2 2026, with ChangXin Storage generating $14.545 billion in revenue and capturing a 9.9% worldwide share, behind Samsung (40.2%), SK Hynix (26.1%) and Micron (21.3%). The company plans to exceed 300,000 wafers per month by the end of 2026 and move toward a long‑term scale of over 600,000 wafers.

Product positioning and patent strategy
ChangXin Technology’s president Cao Kanyu recently disclosed that the company’s first 4F² product will be a server DDR5 RDIMM, slated for customer validation before year‑end.

For its market strategy, ChangXin Storage will apply the first‑generation 4F² architecture directly to enterprise‑grade servers that demand high stability and fault tolerance, and will pair it with the already‑released LPDDR6 mobile storage products, indicating an accelerated push into the high‑margin, high‑end memory market.

items.title: 川普金主選前2周開砲：共和黨去年減稅是錯的　川普對盟友關稅戰是「災難」
items.title_en: Trump's Backer Fires Shots Two Weeks Before Election: GOP's 2023 Tax Cut Was a Mistake, Trump's Tariff War with Allies a "Disaster"
paras: 美國期中選舉倒數2周之際，城堡投資執行長Ken Griffin認為共和黨前景堪憂，並稱川普與美國盟友的爭鬥是問題的一部分。
Griffin週二(20日)在紐約舉行的「全球市場未來大會」(Future of Global Markets Conference)上說，共和黨期中大選選情艱難，川普關稅政策加劇了通膨，並擾亂了供應鏈。
他說：「我認為與加拿大、歐洲及我們的盟友之間的關稅戰簡直是場災難，川普在總統任期剛開始這麼做時我就談過這一點。坦率地說，我不願意這麼說，但我當時是對的。這助長了通膨。這肯定切斷了全球供應鏈。」
今年7月20日，美國總統川普宣布對部分加拿大進口商品加徵50%的關稅，理由是歧視美國汽車、酒類和乳製品出口。這些關稅已於8月生效。
美國9月消費者物價指數(CPI)年增3.7%，而自川普重返白宮以來，通膨幾乎抹去了一班勞工的時薪漲幅。燃料可負擔性和住房供應不足已成為共和黨在期中選舉中的痛點。
Griffin預測，共和黨幾乎肯定會失去對國會至少一院的控制權，並將期中選舉描述為對執政黨的制衡。「眾議院幾乎處於非常艱難的境地，而參議院的選情將非常膠著。」
他還指出，去年美國進一步減稅，是美國國會共和黨人和總統川普犯下的錯誤，美國政府在疫情期間花了很多錢，「我們並沒有延續減稅政策的財政空間」。美國債務已突破40兆美元。
Griffin認為，與增加支出相比，共和黨人過去兩年在減稅一事上問題更大。
他還對川普對伊朗戰爭的解釋有自己的看法，並稱川普政府對待移民的方式「可恥」。「伊朗戰爭非常不受歡迎。我認為他在解釋原因方面做得非常糟糕，我認為總統沒有以有力、有意義的方式向美國人民說明這一點。」
Griffin也指出，他認為應加強邊境安全，但對於已經在這裡的移民，應為他們提供「成為我們社會有貢獻成員的途徑，並幫助發展我們的經濟」。
paras_en: As the U.S. midterm election countdown reaches two weeks, Citadel CEO Ken Griffin says the Republican outlook looks bleak and describes Trump’s disputes with U.S. allies as part of the problem.

Griffin told the Future of Global Markets Conference in New York on Tuesday, the 20th, that the GOP’s midterm prospects are tough, that Trump’s tariff policy has worsened inflation and disrupted supply chains.

He said, “I think the tariff war with Canada, Europe and our allies is a disaster. I warned about this when Trump started his presidency. Frankly, I don’t like saying it, but I was right. It has fed inflation and definitely cut off global supply chains.”
On July 20 this year, President Trump announced a 50% tariff on certain Canadian imports, citing discrimination against U.S. auto, alcohol and dairy exports. The tariffs took effect in August.

U.S. consumer prices rose 3.7% year‑over‑year in September, and since Trump returned to the White House, inflation has almost erased wage gains for many workers. Fuel affordability and a shortage of housing have become pain points for Republicans in the midterms.

Griffin predicts the GOP will almost certainly lose control of at least one chamber of Congress and describes the midterms as a check on the party in power. “The House is in a very tough spot, and the Senate race will be extremely tight,” he said.

He also noted that last year’s further tax cuts were a mistake by Republican lawmakers and Trump, adding that the government spent heavily during the pandemic and “we have no fiscal space to keep cutting taxes.” U.S. debt has now topped $40 trillion.
Griffin argues that, compared with increased spending, the GOP’s tax‑cut agenda over the past two years is the bigger problem.

He offered his own take on Trump’s handling of the war with Iran, calling the administration’s immigration approach “shameful.” “The Iran war is very unpopular. He explained it terribly, and the president failed to communicate the reasons to the American people in a strong, meaningful way,” he said.
Griffin also said he supports stronger border security, but for migrants already here, the U.S. should provide “a path to become contributing members of our society and help grow our economy.”

items.title: AI圈最大騙局？全球大模型排行榜遭質疑 高分不等於好用
items.title_en: The Biggest AI Scam? Global Large Model Rankings Questioned – High Scores Don't Mean Practical Use
paras: 全球AI大廠競相拚跑分，但排行榜第一就代表最好用？隨著AI代理（Agent）開始執行複雜任務，評測標準不一、結果難以重現等問題逐漸浮現。開源AI平台Hugging Face高層指出，模型高分未必能反映實際工作能力，排行榜的侷限正受到關注。
開源AI平台Hugging Face首席政策官Irene Solaiman在TechCrunch Disrupt活動中指出，現有AI評測存在局限。尤其進入AI代理時代，實際表現不只取決於模型，也受到工具呼叫、執行框架及任務環境影響。
這些問題並不代表排行榜毫無價值，但若將單項測試高分直接視為模型的全部能力，恐怕難以判斷產品能否在真實環境中發揮作用。
跑分成行銷利器 高分未必能完成工作
從MMLU、GPQA到SWE-bench，各類知識、數學、程式設計與推理測試，已成為AI業者展示能力的重要工具。統一題目及評分方式，有助開發者觀察技術進步，也讓企業得以比較不同模型。
然而，測試環境與商業應用仍有落差。一款模型可能擅長解數學題，卻無法穩定完成複雜的軟體開發工作；另一款模型即使在程式設計榜單名列前茅，進入企業系統後，也可能因工具呼叫失敗、上下文管理混亂或權限限制，無法完成任務。
不同業者使用的測試設定、提示詞、推理預算與工具環境也可能不同。即使採用相同基準測試，成績未必能直接比較。當排名成為行銷依據，單一分數的侷限更容易被忽略。
同一個模型 搭配不同工具結果就不同
Solaiman提出的評測問題，主要涉及標準是否統一、透明且可重複，以及AI系統能力已超出傳統單一模型測試的範圍。
在AI代理應用中，相同底層模型搭配不同工具、提示詞策略與執行框架，可能交出明顯不同的成果。
例如，同樣要求AI修復軟體漏洞，一套系統可能只提供修改建議，另一套卻能搜尋程式碼、呼叫測試工具、修改檔案並驗證結果。若只比較程式碼生成分數，便難以完整衡量兩者的工作能力。
因此，評測重點正從模型能否回答問題，轉向整套系統能否可靠地完成任務。
AI代理好不好用 還要看成本與安全
AI代理與傳統聊天機器人的主要差別，在於不再只是回答問題，而是開始執行工作。過程可能涉及存取資料庫、瀏覽網頁、撰寫程式及呼叫外部工具，甚至連續運作數小時。
這使得任務完成率成為重要指標。產生看似正確的答案，不等於真正解決問題；面對相同任務時，能否持續交付一致成果，也關係到企業能否放心採用。
成本同樣不能忽略。即使AI代理能完成工作，若耗費大量Token，或反覆呼叫高價模型，商業價值仍可能受限。能否遵守權限界線、避免資料外洩，並在高風險操作前取得授權，也應納入能力評估。
換言之，評測不只要看模型有多聰明，還要確認系統能否把事情做完、做對，並控制成本。
企業挑模型 從看排名轉向看實效
對OpenAI、Google及Anthropic等業者而言，排行榜仍具有宣傳價值，但單靠跑分領先，未必能建立長期競爭優勢。開源模型陣營也正透過較低推理成本及靈活部署方式參與競爭。
企業採購時，模型能否串接既有系統、處理真實資料、穩定執行任務，以及符合安全與合規要求，往往比榜單上的幾分差距更重要。市場競爭也可能從通用能力比較，進一步轉向特定應用與完整系統的表現。
基準測試仍是衡量技術進步的重要工具，真正需要調整的是將單項成績等同於全部能力的評價方式。未來評測須同時涵蓋任務完成率、成本、穩定性、安全性與結果可重複性。
當AI走向商業部署，業者除了證明模型能拿高分，更須證明產品能穩定解決真實問題。
paras_en: Global AI giants are racing to post high benchmark scores, but does being first on the leaderboard mean a model is the most useful? As AI agents begin to perform complex tasks, issues such as inconsistent evaluation standards and irreproducible results are surfacing. Executives at the open‑source AI platform Hugging Face note that a high score does not necessarily reflect real‑world work capability, and the limitations of these rankings are drawing scrutiny.

Irene Solaiman, Chief Policy Officer at Hugging Face, told TechCrunch Disrupt that current AI evaluations have clear shortcomings. In the emerging era of AI agents, actual performance depends not only on the model itself but also on tool calls, execution frameworks, and the task environment.
These problems do not render rankings worthless, but treating a single high‑score test as a model’s entire ability makes it hard to judge whether a product will work in real settings.
Score‑driven marketing – high scores don’t guarantee task completion

From MMLU and GPQA to SWE‑bench, a variety of knowledge, math, coding and reasoning tests have become key tools for AI firms to showcase capability. Uniform questions and scoring methods help developers track progress and let businesses compare different models.

However, test environments differ from commercial use. A model might excel at solving math problems yet fail to reliably handle complex software development work; another model that tops coding leaderboards may stumble in enterprise systems due to tool‑call failures, context‑management issues, or permission restrictions.

Different vendors also use varying test settings, prompts, inference budgets and tool stacks. Even with the same benchmark, scores may not be directly comparable. When rankings become marketing fodder, the limits of a single number are easy to overlook.
The same model can yield different results when paired with different tools
Solaiman’s critique centers on whether standards are uniform, transparent and repeatable, and whether AI system capabilities have outgrown the scope of traditional single‑model testing.
In AI‑agent applications, the same underlying model combined with different tools, prompting strategies and execution frameworks can produce markedly different outcomes.

For example, when asked to fix a software bug, one system might only suggest a patch, while another can search the codebase, invoke testing tools, modify files and verify the fix. Comparing only code‑generation scores would miss the broader work capability.
Thus, evaluation focus is shifting from whether a model can answer a question to whether the entire system can reliably complete a task.
Is an AI agent useful? It also depends on cost and safety

The main difference between AI agents and traditional chatbots is that agents do more than answer questions – they start to perform work. This may involve accessing databases, browsing the web, writing code, calling external tools, and even running continuously for hours.

Consequently, task‑completion rate becomes a crucial metric. Generating seemingly correct answers does not equal solving the problem; the ability to consistently deliver results on the same task also determines whether enterprises can trust the technology.

Cost cannot be ignored either. Even if an AI agent completes a job, high token consumption or repeated calls to expensive models can limit commercial value. Adhering to permission boundaries, preventing data leaks, and obtaining authorization before high‑risk actions should also factor into capability assessments.
In other words, evaluations must look beyond model intelligence to confirm that the system can finish tasks correctly and control costs.
Enterprises shift from ranking‑centric to effectiveness‑centric model selection

For players like OpenAI, Google and Anthropic, rankings still have promotional value, but leading on scores alone may not secure a lasting competitive edge. Open‑source model camps are also entering the fray with lower inference costs and flexible deployment options.

When purchasing, companies care more about whether a model can integrate with existing systems, handle real data, run tasks stably, and meet security and compliance requirements than about a few points difference on a leaderboard. Market competition may evolve from comparing general capabilities to assessing performance in specific applications and complete systems.

Benchmarks remain important tools for measuring technical progress, but what needs to change is equating a single test score with overall ability. Future evaluations should cover task‑completion rates, cost, stability, safety and reproducibility of results.
As AI moves toward commercial deployment, vendors must not only prove that their models can achieve high scores, but also demonstrate that their products can consistently solve real‑world problems.

items.title: 〈焦點股〉CCL報價漲、外資調高目標價 南亞盤中奔漲停
items.title_en: Focus Stock: CCL Prices Rise, Foreign Investors Raise Target Price; Nanya Soars Mid‑day to Upper Limit
paras: 台股今(21)日展開大反攻，南亞(1303-TW)受惠於中國銅箔基板(CCL)龍頭廠建滔傳出已向客戶發出漲價通知，加上AI伺服器需求持續升溫、高階玻璃纖維布供應吃緊，外資麥格理、瑞銀均調升南亞目標價，激勵南亞今日開高走高，盤中觸及漲停價325.5元，站上5日、10日均線，單日成交量也已連續7個交易日突破10萬張。
外資瑞銀證券及麥格理證券均看好南亞後市，認為南亞在CCL業務的產品毛利率優於預期，加上轉投資的南亞科(2408-TW)、台塑化(6505-TW)可望挹注獲利，紛紛調升南亞目標價至390元以上。
此外，根據建滔發出的通知，玻纖布市場需求旺盛，上游高階玻璃纖維布及玻璃紗供應緊張，10月玻纖布價格漲幅超過10%，以玻纖布為生產原料的上游產品，銷售價格也調漲15%。
法人表示，南亞受惠於AI基礎建設強勢擴張，持續強化電子材料高階產品的開發與認證，並著眼於電子材料、IC載板、CCL及上游記憶體等領域的供需變化，持續推進高階材料布局。法人樂觀看待高階銅箔基板需求成長，認為產業需求可望持續暢旺至2030年。
南亞目前在CCL高階材料升級方面，已進入產品驗證與出貨並行階段，HVLP4供應逐步穩定，M7、M8規格CCL已出貨，M9、M10則進入客戶認證階段，其中M10最快有望於明(2027)年上半年取得客戶初步認證。
展望第4季，南亞先前預期，10月及第4季業績有望持續攀升，第4季營運可望優於第3季，全年營收有機會再創歷史新高，公司對明年展望也相當樂觀。
paras_en: Taiwan stocks launched a strong counter‑attack today (the 21st), with Nanya (1303‑TW) benefiting from a price‑increase notice issued by CCL leader Jiantao to its customers. Coupled with sustained heating demand for AI servers and tight supply of high‑end glass fiber cloth, foreign investors Macquarie and UBS both raised Nanya’s target price, spurring the stock to open higher and climb, hitting the daily limit of NT$325.5, breaking above the 5‑day and 10‑day moving averages, and its daily volume has now exceeded 100,000 shares for seven consecutive trading days.

Foreign investors UBS Securities and Macquarie Securities are both bullish on Nanya’s outlook, believing its product gross margin in the CCL business exceeds expectations. In addition, its affiliates Nanya Technology (2408‑TW) and Formosa Plastics Corp. (6505‑TW) are expected to contribute earnings, prompting them to lift Nanya’s target price to above NT$390.

Moreover, according to Jiantao’s notice, demand for glass fiber cloth is robust, and upstream supplies of high‑end glass fiber cloth and glass yarn are tight. In October, glass fiber cloth prices rose more than 10%, and upstream products that use the cloth as raw material saw sales prices increase by 15%.

Institutional investors said Nanya is benefiting from the strong expansion of AI infrastructure, continuously strengthening the development and certification of high‑end electronic material products, and focusing on supply‑demand shifts in electronic materials, IC substrates, CCL and upstream memory sectors, while advancing its high‑end material layout. They are optimistic about growth in high‑end copper foil substrate demand, expecting industry demand to remain vigorous through 2030.

Nanya is currently in the product verification and shipment phase for upgrading high‑end CCL materials. HVLP4 supply is gradually stabilizing, M7 and M8‑spec CCL have been shipped, while M9 and M10 are in customer certification stages, with M10 potentially receiving initial customer certification as early as the first half of 2027.

Looking ahead to Q4, Nanya previously projected that October and Q4 performance would continue to rise, with Q4 operations expected to outperform Q3. Full‑year revenue could set a new historical high, and the company is also very optimistic about its outlook for next year.

items.title: Sony出售逾400項XR專利給Meta  這對蘋果Vision Pro遊戲來說是個問題
items.title_en: Sony Sells Over 400 XR Patents to Meta, Raising Concerns for Apple Vision Pro Gaming
paras: 全球虛擬實境(VR)市場再傳震撼異動！科技媒體《AppleInsider》指出，日本科技巨擘 Sony(SONY-US)已正式將旗下多達 419 件延展實境(XR)相關專利移轉給 Meta(META-US)。隨著 Sony 旗下的 PlayStation VR2(PS VR2)裝置與控制器近來頻傳停產、市面供貨極度吃緊，這筆交易不僅引發外界對 Sony 是否將逐步淡出 VR 硬體市場的猜測，更意外對蘋果(AAPL-US)Vision Pro 的遊戲生態布局投下一枚不確定炸彈。
這起專利交易最早由韓國媒體《ZDNet Korea》披露，隨後由 VR 專業媒體《Road to VR》引述報導。雙方於 2025 年 12 月簽署專利移轉確認協議，涵蓋 180 件美國專利，以及在日本、中國、南韓、歐洲等地提出的 239 件同族專利申請，技術範圍包括 XR 應用運算處理、頭戴式顯示器設計及相關硬體。
《ZDNet Korea》10 月 5 日報導指出，當時美國專利商標局紀錄顯示，已有 43 件美國專利於今年 6 至 9 月分批登錄移轉至 Meta。Sony 與 Meta 均未公開宣布交易細節，Sony 也未說明未來 VR 硬體布局。
PS VR2 近月供貨吃緊，市場並傳出頭戴裝置與控制器已停止生產。
不過，《AppleInsider》引用的《GamesRadar+》報導明確指出，PlayStation 尚未證實 PS VR2 停產，因此仍不能據此認定 Sony 將退出 VR 硬體市場。
這項發展之所以牽動蘋果，在於 Vision Pro 已透過 visionOS 26 加入對 PS VR2 Sense 控制器的支援。
蘋果自 2025 年 11 月 11 日起，在美國官方線上商店販售控制器與充電座套裝，售價為 249.95 美元。
Vision Pro 原本以眼球追蹤與手勢操作為主要互動方式，但許多 VR 遊戲依賴手持控制器。加入 PS VR2 Sense 支援後，玩家可使用六自由度動作追蹤、手指觸碰偵測與震動功能，拓展 Vision Pro 的沉浸式遊戲體驗。
《AppleInsider》分析，這筆專利交易目前對 Vision Pro 的主要疑慮在於控制器後續供應。若 Sony 未來停止供應相關配件，現有庫存又逐步耗盡，可能增加新用戶取得控制器的難度，並為蘋果拓展 VR 遊戲帶來挑戰。
蘋果可能的因應方向包括擴大第三方 VR 控制器支援，或與其他遊戲硬體業者合作。
Vision Pro 雖已支援多款傳統遊戲手把，但對需要追蹤手部位置與動作的沉浸式遊戲而言，VR 控制器仍有其用途。
自行開發也是報導提出的可能選項。
9 月曝光的系統程式碼線索顯示，蘋果可能正在開發兩款遊戲控制器，但相關設計偏向傳統類型，尚無法確認是否將推出 Vision Pro 專用 VR 控制器。上述方向仍屬媒體分析，蘋果尚未公布相關計畫。
paras_en: The global virtual reality (VR) market is shaking again. Tech outlet AppleInsider reports that Japanese tech giant Sony (SONY-US) has officially transferred a total of 419 extended reality (XR)‑related patents to Meta (META-US). With Sony’s PlayStation VR2 (PS VR2) headset and controllers recently rumored to be discontinued and supply extremely tight, the deal has sparked speculation that Sony may be gradually exiting the VR hardware market and has unexpectedly thrown an uncertainty bomb into Apple’s (AAPL-US) Vision Pro gaming ecosystem.

The patent deal was first disclosed by South Korea’s ZDNet Korea and later cited by VR‑focused site Road to VR. The parties signed a patent‑transfer agreement in December 2025 covering 180 U.S. patents and 239 family‑patent applications filed in Japan, China, South Korea, Europe and elsewhere, spanning XR application processing, headset design and related hardware.

ZDNet Korea reported on October 5 that the U.S. Patent and Trademark Office records show 43 U.S. patents were logged for transfer to Meta in batches between June and September of this year. Neither Sony nor Meta has released details of the transaction, and Sony has not commented on its future VR hardware strategy.
PS VR2 supply has been tight in recent weeks, and market chatter suggests the headset and its controllers have already stopped production.
However, AppleInsider cites a GamesRadar+ report that PlayStation has not confirmed a PS VR2 shutdown, so it cannot yet be concluded that Sony is exiting the VR hardware market.
The development matters to Apple because Vision Pro, via visionOS 26, now supports the PS VR2 Sense controller.
Since November 11 2025, Apple has been selling a controller‑and‑charging‑dock bundle on its U.S. online store for $249.95.

Vision Pro originally relied on eye‑tracking and hand‑gesture interaction, but many VR games depend on handheld controllers. With PS VR2 Sense support, users can enjoy six‑degree‑of‑freedom motion tracking, finger‑touch detection and haptic feedback, expanding Vision Pro’s immersive gaming experience.

AppleInsider analyses that the main concern for Vision Pro from this patent deal is the future supply of the controller. If Sony stops providing the accessories and existing inventory dwindles, new users may find it harder to obtain the controller, posing a challenge for Apple’s VR gaming expansion.
Apple could respond by broadening third‑party VR controller support or partnering with other gaming‑hardware companies.
Although Vision Pro already supports several traditional gamepads, VR controllers remain important for immersive titles that require hand‑position and motion tracking.
In‑house development is another option mentioned in the report.

A September leak of system code hints that Apple may be working on two game controllers, but the designs lean toward conventional styles, and it is unclear whether a Vision Pro‑specific VR controller will be released. These ideas are still media speculation; Apple has not announced any related plans.

items.title: AI熱潮推升大立光等科技業布局台中 產業園區工業地產最搶手
items.title_en: AI Boom Boosts Tech Companies' Expansion in Taichung; Industrial Real Estate in Parks Most In‑Demand
paras: 美光中科后里園區的先進封裝測試二廠日前啟用，台積電(2330-TW)中科擴建二期新廠也預計自2027年起陸續完工投產。除了美光、台積電外，上市櫃科技業者也積極布局台中，截至今年第三季，已有8家企業在台中購廠、購地，其中以大立光(3008-TW)出手最大，陸續購入台中產業園區、精密機械科技園區等地的7座廠房，合計斥資超過80.8億元。
此外，志聖(2467-TW)、信邦(3023-TW)、萬潤(6187-TW)、鴻勁(7769-TW)、創新服務(7828-TW)等半導體相關業者，也分別在精密機械科技園區、台中港、大雅、大甲等地布局，8家科技業者合計投入逾130億元，購入超過3萬坪產業用地，顯示台中在AI產業發展帶動下，持續吸引科技業者進駐。
台灣房屋集團趨勢中心資深經理陳定中表示，近年AI熱潮帶動科技業快速發展，半導體、伺服器、高階製造、光元件、自動化設備及精密加工等領域的需求均快速成長。台中本身擁有完整的精密機械聚落及金屬加工供應鏈，加上美光、台積電等大廠持續擴大中科園區布局，吸引相關科技產業進駐，有助於上下游廠商緊密整合，也可運用台中位居台灣中部的地理優勢，串聯陸海空交通及物流網絡，進一步提升企業進駐意願。
觀察企業投資台中的區段，以台中產業園區最受青睞，單是大立光就購入5座廠房，萬潤、頌勝(7768-TW)、崴寶精密(7744-TW)也都選擇在台中產業園區布局。
陳定中指出，台中產業園區位於中科台中園區與精密機械科技園區之間，可提供企業從基礎零件到高階技術的產業支援，加上周邊交通網絡完善，鄰近台74線、國道1號及國道3號，距離台中港、台中國際機場也不遠，與七期商貿中心僅一橋之隔，兼具廠區生產、產品運輸及商務往來等需求，成為科技大廠拓展版圖的熱門選擇。
台灣房屋七期單元特許加盟店店東陳裕方表示，由中科、台中產業園區及精密機械科技園區構成的大肚山產業走廊，是台中招商引資的熱點。周邊環繞中科水堀頭、單元一、嶺東文山、龍井東海及沙鹿新光田等五大商圈，隨著園區發展帶動就業人口增加，未來可望吸引自住需求進場，帶動周邊房市發展。
陳裕方指出，五大商圈中，中科水堀頭商圈聯外交通最便利，加上捷運藍線建設話題，新案高價已來到7、8字頭，與低密度開發的單元一別墅區同屬高總價區段，未來較有機會吸引產業高階主管及企業主青睞。
至於嶺東文山、龍井東海及沙鹿新光田，目前新案平均單價普遍落在4字頭，產品則以2、3房、總價較低的小宅為主，較符合園區基層就業族群的購屋需求。
paras_en: Micron’s advanced packaging test second factory in the Houcheng (Houli) park was recently inaugurated, and TSMC (2330‑TW) plans to complete its Phase‑2 expansion of the Central Taiwan Science Park (CTSP) plant starting in 2027. In addition to Micron and TSMC, listed tech firms are actively setting up in Taichung; by the third quarter of this year, eight companies have bought factories or land there, with Largan Precision (3008‑TW) making the biggest move, acquiring seven factories in the Taichung Industrial Park, the Precision Machinery Science Park and other sites, spending more than NT$8.08 billion.

In addition, semiconductor‑related firms such as Zhi‑Sheng (2467‑TW), Xinbang (3023‑TW), Wan‑Run (6187‑TW), Hong‑Jin (7769‑TW) and Innovation Services (7828‑TW) have each set up operations in the Precision Machinery Science Park, Taichung Port, Daya and Dajia. The eight tech companies together have invested over NT$13 billion and bought more than 30,000 ping of industrial land, showing that Taichung continues to attract tech players as AI‑driven industry growth accelerates.

Chen Ding‑zhong, senior manager at the Trend Center of Taiwan Housing Group, said the recent AI surge has spurred rapid growth in the tech sector, with soaring demand for semiconductors, servers, advanced manufacturing, optoelectronic components, automation equipment and precision machining. Taichung already boasts a complete precision‑machinery cluster and metal‑processing supply chain, and the continued expansion of major players such as Micron and TSMC in the CTSP draws related industries, facilitating tight upstream‑downstream integration and leveraging Taichung’s central location to link land, sea and air transport and logistics networks, further boosting corporate interest.

Looking at where firms invest in Taichung, the Taichung Industrial Park is the most popular. Largan alone bought five factories there, while Wan‑Run, Song‑Sheng (7768‑TW) and Wei‑Bao Precision (7744‑TW) also chose the Taichung Industrial Park for their sites.

Chen noted that the Taichung Industrial Park sits between the CTSP and the Precision Machinery Science Park, offering companies support from basic components to high‑end technologies. Its surrounding transport network is well‑developed, with easy access to Provincial Highway 74, National Freeways 1 and 3, and it is close to Taichung Port and Taichung International Airport. It is also just across a bridge from the Qiqi Commercial Center, meeting needs for production, product shipping and business interaction, making it a hot choice for large tech firms expanding their footprints.

Chen Yu‑fang, franchise owner of a Taiwan Housing branch in the Qiqi district, said the Da‑du‑Shan industrial corridor—formed by the CTSP, Taichung Industrial Park and the Precision Machinery Science Park—is a hotspot for investment in Taichung. The area is surrounded by five major commercial zones: CTSP Shuikou‑Tou, Unit 1, Ling‑Dong Wenshan, Long‑Jing Donghai and Shalu Xinguangtian. As the parks develop and employment rises, residential demand is expected to grow, spurring the surrounding housing market.

Chen added that among the five commercial zones, the CTSP Shuikou‑Tou area enjoys the best external transport links. With the upcoming MRT Blue Line, new projects are already fetching high‑seven‑digit prices, comparable to the low‑density villa area of Unit 1, placing both in the high‑total‑price segment and likely to attract senior industry executives and business owners in the future.

As for Ling‑Dong Wenshan, Long‑Jing Donghai and Shalu Xinguangtian, current new‑project average prices generally sit in the four‑digit‑thousands range, offering mainly two‑ or three‑room small homes at lower total prices, which better match the home‑buying needs of the parks’ rank‑and‑file workers.

items.title: 全球資金撤離AI股後到哪去了？富達：A股科技股處磨底階段　AI應用端將誕生「百倍股」
items.title_en: Where Did Global Capital Flow After Exiting AI Stocks? Fidelity: A-Share Tech Stocks Are in a Bottom‑Polishing Phase, AI Applications May Yield "Hundred‑Fold" Stocks
paras: 全球AI股近一個月遭集中拋售，地緣政治與宏觀風險升溫下，市場對OpenAI、Anthropic等模型公司估值產生質疑，A股科技股亦呈「美股映射」式劇烈波動。對此富達基金經理聶毅翔指出，A股科技股前期下跌主因交易擁擠與資金流出，基本面未明顯惡化，但短期波動加劇，左側抄底難度大，中長期仍看好AI前景，認為相比已大漲的基礎設施，應用端更可能誕生「百倍股」。
談及模型估值爭議，聶毅翔表示，牛市看天花板如市銷率，熊市看現金流。高利率環境壓制成長股，是AI標的走弱關鍵。

他並以SpaceX為例，該公司上市估值1.77兆美元但仍淨虧損，早期交易風險高，禁售期後拋壓大，大模型估值同樣難用傳統模型衡量，依賴技術革命信念。若Anthropic等年度經常性收入(ARR)保持高速成長，遠期估值可被消化，但關鍵在成長確定性與利率走向。此外，當前地緣政治摩擦與高油價推升美國升息機率，美國9月CPI年增3.7%，核心CPI升至2.6%，雙超預期，市場對Fed升息押注升溫，利率敏感型科技股承壓明顯。
聶毅翔認為，AI發展類似2000年網路泡沫後的早期階段，短期市場消化估值後，下一步重點轉向應用。相比基礎設施，應用端更可能誕生「百倍股」，但大模型公司也在向下做應用，如智能體和辦公工具，曾導致軟體股大跌。
他指出，真正有潛力的應用公司需具備兩大特徵：擁有獨有數據或場景(如醫療、法律、金融等垂直領域)，且毛利率能扛住推理成本。投資應用落地比在基建高位追高更具性價比，但需要極大確信度與耐心。
A股方面，聶毅翔指出下跌主因交易擁擠和資金流出，今年Q3財報顯示基本面依然強勁，但新增資金觀望。A股雖處於降息環境，但科技股高度映射美股利息週期和地緣情緒，波動加劇，「殺估值」持續多久難判斷，目前仍處「磨底階段」。
對於光模組等標的，聶毅翔稱產業基本面強勁，算力成長帶動光模組需求非線性上升，但殺估值過程中負面消息易被放大，例如近期某法律團隊傳出的「65%美國含量」規則導致大跌，該消息並非FCC正式討論的規則。光模組物料成本中DSP和光芯片以美系、日系為主，中國國內組裝廠滿足該比例並非難事，但下行期間市場情緒脆弱，負面情緒被擴大。
半導體方面，中國自給率上升是確定長期趨勢，設備受益於國產替代。中國企業在光模組領域具全球競爭力，資本開支拐點看台積電、艾司摩爾等上游訂單，目前訂單飽滿，說明下游需求強勁，尚未出現產能過剩。
交易策略上，聶毅翔建議右側確認優於左側抄底，左側難以精準捕捉最低點，易導致持續浮虧和贖回壓力。右側結合基本面、技術面與市場信號，在趨勢相對確定後介入，雖可能錯過底部10%-20%漲幅，但能確保買入即獲利，形成安全墊。關鍵是區分「頂部」與「早期右側」，避免在情緒狂熱時接盤。
paras_en: Global AI stocks have faced concentrated selling over the past month. Amid rising geopolitical and macro risks, the market is questioning the valuations of model companies such as OpenAI and Anthropic, and A‑share technology stocks have shown the same dramatic, "U.S.‑stock‑mirrored" volatility. Fidelity fund manager Nie Yixiang said the earlier decline in A‑share tech stocks was mainly due to crowded trading and capital outflows; fundamentals have not noticeably deteriorated, but short‑term volatility has intensified, making left‑side bottom‑fishing difficult. He remains bullish on AI in the medium to long term and believes that, compared with the already soaring infrastructure sector, the application side is more likely to produce "hundred‑fold" stocks.

Discussing the valuation debate for models, Nie Yixiang noted that in a bull market investors look at ceiling metrics like price‑to‑sales, while in a bear market they focus on cash flow. A high‑interest‑rate environment suppresses growth stocks and is a key reason for the weakness in AI targets.

He cited SpaceX as an example: the company’s market valuation at IPO was $1.77 trillion despite still posting net losses, making early‑stage trading risky and leading to heavy selling pressure after lock‑up periods. Valuations of large models are similarly hard to gauge with traditional models and rely on belief in a technological revolution. If companies like Anthropic maintain rapid growth in annual recurring revenue (ARR), their long‑term valuations could be justified, but the key factors are growth certainty and the direction of interest rates. Moreover, current geopolitical frictions and high oil prices have raised the probability of U.S. rate hikes; U.S. CPI for September rose 3.7% year‑on‑year, core CPI to 2.6%, both well above expectations, prompting the market to bet more aggressively on Fed tightening, which has put pressure on rate‑sensitive tech stocks.

Nie Yixiang believes AI development is akin to the early stage after the 2000 internet bubble: after short‑term market digestion of valuations, the focus will shift to applications. Compared with infrastructure, the application side is more likely to generate "hundred‑fold" stocks, though large‑model firms are also moving down‑the‑stack into applications such as agents and office tools, which have previously caused software stocks to tumble.

He pointed out that truly promising application companies need two key traits: exclusive data or scenarios (e.g., verticals like healthcare, legal, finance) and gross margins that can absorb inference costs. Investing in applied roll‑outs offers better risk‑adjusted returns than chasing high‑priced infrastructure stocks, but it requires strong conviction and patience.

Regarding A‑shares, Nie Yixiang said the decline was driven by crowded trading and capital outflows. Q3 earnings this year show fundamentals remain robust, yet new capital is cautious. Although A‑shares are in a rate‑cut environment, tech stocks are highly correlated with U.S. interest‑rate cycles and geopolitical sentiment, amplifying volatility. How long the "valuation‑killing" phase will last is hard to judge, and the market is still in a "bottom‑polishing" stage.

On optical‑module stocks, Nie Yixiang said the industry fundamentals are strong; growth in computing power drives a non‑linear rise in demand for optical modules. However, during the valuation‑cutting process, negative news can be amplified—for example, a recent rumor from a legal team about a "65% U.S. content" rule caused a sharp drop, even though the rule is not an official FCC proposal. The material costs for optical modules, such as DSPs and optical chips, are dominated by U.S. and Japanese suppliers; Chinese domestic assemblers can meet the required ratios, but market sentiment is fragile in downtrends, magnifying negative emotions.

In semiconductors, China’s rising self‑sufficiency rate is a clear long‑term trend, benefiting equipment as domestic substitutes grow. Chinese firms are globally competitive in optical modules, and capital‑expenditure turning points are linked to upstream orders from TSMC, ASML and others. Current orders are full, indicating strong downstream demand and no sign of overcapacity yet.

For trading strategy, Nie Yixiang recommends right‑side confirmation over left‑side bottom‑fishing. The left side is hard to pinpoint the exact low, often leading to sustained floating losses and redemption pressure. The right side combines fundamentals, technicals and market signals, entering after the trend is relatively certain. While this may miss the first 10%‑20% upside from the bottom, it ensures buying at profit and creates a safety cushion. The key is to distinguish between a "top" and an "early right side" and avoid taking positions during emotional frenzies.

items.title_en: Xinchang Electronics' New Project Volume Surges Fivefold, Expanding Its Three Core Market Deployments
paras: 鑫創電子(6680-TW)表示，隨著全球國防自主化、智慧交通及工業自動化加速導入邊緣AI，公司積極擴大三大核心市場布局，今年新專案與新產品開案量已突破去年同期5倍，市場拓展與產品開發動能持續升溫。
鑫創電子董事長許育瑞指出，AI應用正從概念驗證走向實際部署，帶動軍工、智慧交通及工業自動化市場對高可靠性邊緣AI平台的需求。其中，軍工無人載具、自動駕駛及工業機器人等自主系統，須在通訊受限、極端環境及即時決策等條件下運作，對運算效能、散熱能力及系統可靠性提出更高要求。
在軍工市場方面，許育瑞表示，強固型邊緣AI平台已應用於國際國防系統整合商的無人地面載具專案，支援自主導航、多感測器融合及運動控制，協助提升自主系統在複雜環境中的運作效率與可靠性。隨著全球國防科技朝無人化與自主化發展，無人地面載具(UGV)、自主偵察平台及軍用機器人等應用，持續帶動相關運算需求。
除軍工應用外，鑫創電子也拓展智慧交通與工業自動化市場，鎖定自動駕駛、智慧軌道運輸、機器視覺及自主移動機器人(AMR)等應用，並透過技術創新與國際系統整合商合作，推動新專案設計導入，加速後續量產商機轉化，藉由新產品開發及專案導入，推升後續業務成長動能。
paras_en: Xinchang Electronics (6680‑TW) said that as global defense autonomy, smart transportation, and industrial automation accelerate the adoption of edge AI, the company is actively expanding its three core market deployments. This year, the number of new projects and new product launches has already exceeded the same period last year by five times, with market expansion and product development momentum continuing to heat up.

Chairman Hsu Yu‑Jui noted that AI applications are moving from proof‑of‑concept to actual deployment, driving demand for high‑reliability edge AI platforms in the defense, smart transportation, and industrial automation markets. In particular, autonomous systems such as military unmanned vehicles, autonomous driving, and industrial robots must operate under limited communications, extreme environments, and real‑time decision‑making, imposing higher requirements on computing performance, thermal management, and system reliability.

Regarding the defense market, Hsu said that rugged edge AI platforms have already been applied to unmanned ground vehicle projects for international defense system integrators, supporting autonomous navigation, multi‑sensor fusion, and motion control, and helping improve the efficiency and reliability of autonomous systems in complex environments. As global defense technology trends toward unmanned and autonomous solutions, applications such as unmanned ground vehicles (UGV), autonomous reconnaissance platforms, and military robots continue to drive related computing demand.

Beyond defense, Xinchang Electronics is also expanding into smart transportation and industrial automation, targeting applications such as autonomous driving, smart rail transport, machine vision, and autonomous mobile robots (AMR). Through technological innovation and cooperation with international system integrators, the company is promoting new project design adoption, accelerating the conversion of subsequent mass‑production opportunities, and boosting future business growth through new product development and project implementation.

items.title: 營收創新高，股價卻反轉？從半導體設備股看懂「營收週期」與「股價週期」的差別
items.title_en: Revenue Hits Record Highs, Yet Stock Prices Reverse? Understanding the Difference Between the "Revenue Cycle" and the "Stock Price Cycle" in Semiconductor Equipment Stocks
paras: 投資人經常會遇到一個問題：一家公司的營收持續創下歷史新高，代表產業需求很好，但為什麼股價不一定跟著上漲？反過來說，如果公司這個月營收創高，下個月卻沒有再創高，是不是就代表成長結束，應該考慮賣出股票？
這個問題其實涉及投資研究中非常重要的觀念：公司的營收成長週期，與股票市場的價格週期，並不一定同步。而不同步的原因，其實跟市場能否提前預期到這件事的發生有關。
尤其半導體設備產業，從客戶決定擴產、設備廠接獲訂單，到設備交付、驗收並認列營收，中間可能相隔數個季度。所以，其實當市場已知客戶要建置多少產能之後，未來營收與發生的時程早已被確定好了，當設備商正式進入交付設備的周期時，由於這些營收早就被預估到了，市場當然不會對這種【已知】訊息有所反應。

同樣是營收創高，為什麼設備股與其他產業的股價反應不同？
如果你想了解什麼是產業循環，半導體設備股一直都是非常棒的案例。為什麼呢？
因為半導體建廠需要很長的時間，從客戶決定擴產、設備商接到訂單，到最後設備交付、驗收並認列營收，中間可能相隔一年以上。前面準備了這麼久，一旦客戶的廠房建置完成，開始大量安裝機台，設備商就會進入密集交貨的階段，營收可能集中在短短幾個季度快速成長，甚至連續創下歷史新高。
可是，等到客戶這一輪需要的設備都安裝完成，採購需求就可能迅速下降。除非客戶繼續擴充既有產線，或有新的廠房準備裝機，否則設備商就得等待下一波訂單。
所以你會發現，半導體設備產業有一個很鮮明的特性：前面花很長時間準備，後面集中幾個季度交貨，交完之後又要等待下一輪擴產。
這就是為什麼半導體設備股的循環性特別強，也解釋了為什麼營收明明還在創高，股價卻可能已經提前反映下一波訂單減少的風險。
從折現模型的角度來看，即使公司的長期需求沒有變差，只要這一波營收高峰已經過去，而下一波獲利成長還需要等待很長一段時間，中間等待的時間就是風險，尤其是半導體的周期長達一年以上，且接單風險又那麼大。

分析實例：萬潤2023~2024年的營收成長周期
比如說先進封裝CoWoS設備股的萬潤(6187-TW)，我們可以從過往的合約負債佔營收比重來看，合約負債等於客戶預付款（俗稱訂金），當合約負債除以營收後的比例很高，代表當下萬潤的營收（交貨數量）相對低、接單金額（未來要交貨）可能很高，這是一個相對領先的指標，可以被視為接到大量訂單的時間點，也就是下圖的2023Q2。
換句話說，投資人在2023年就可以確定2024年會大幅成長，會成長多少也早就能被分析師估算出來，因為半導體製造客戶的資本支出是早就規劃好的。加上半導體設備沒辦法臨時更換供應商，所以這件事幾乎不會有什麼變數，所以股價會提前反應是相當合理的預期，並非炒作。而越接近認列的時間點，催化劑越大，股價反應越激烈也是相當合理的現象。
我們來看一下，從接單到實際交貨營收認列，時間究竟可以拉的多長。
早在2023年第二季，萬潤的合約負債就已經出現明顯的接單訊號，而接單之後要準備零件存貨，如下圖所示，公司確實也是在接單後（2023年下半到2024上半年之間），準備了大量未來要交貨的零組件。
但以營收來看，這一波訂單卻要等到2024年下半年，才陸續交貨並轉換成實際的營收與獲利。中間相隔了一年多。藉由這張圖，我們可以觀察股價究竟在什麼時候開始反映這些成長。
不難發現，萬潤在2023年Q2出現接單訊號之後，股價其實就已經開始大幅上漲。但真正漲幅最明顯的階段，是2024年，也就是設備即將大量交貨、營收準備快速成長的那一年。
你會發現，等到營收真正開始大幅成長時，股價雖然還在上漲，但漲勢已經明顯放慢。等到設備商進入大量交貨、營收集中認列的季度，股價反而見到高點，隨後開始反轉。
這裡還要注意一個時間差：月營收通常是在次月才公布，所以當投資人從財報數字看到營收創高時，股價可能早就提前反映了。

學到什麼操作技巧？操作週期應該與能見度相匹配
當一個產業從接單到營收實現，需要一年甚至更長的時間，我們就應該把分析時間拉長，以「年度」為單位，來提前判斷股價的循環。
為什麼呢？因為這類產業今年會認列多少營收、什麼時候認列，市場可能早在一年前，就已經從客戶的擴產計畫與設備訂單，大致推估出來了。
所以，研究這類股票時，就不能只追著月營收跑，等到營收創下歷史新高才買進。對於提前布局的投資人來說，月營收進入認列高峰，反而可能是開始尋找賣點的時候。
這也就是為什麼，我們在研究長週期產業時，一定要觀察法人對於下一年度的營收與EPS預估，以及這些預估值是否持續上修或下修。這個指標可以幫助投資人彌補很關鍵的資訊落差，如果市場上所有法人都已知道明年會有多少需求與交機量，這時候如果還用盲猜的，資訊上肯定落後市場一大截。
舉個例子，如果設備商在2026年接到大量訂單，但預計2027年才會集中交貨，那麼我們在2026年研究這家公司時，重點就不應該只是當月營收有沒有創高，而是明年（2027年）的營收與EPS可能成長多少，以及市場什麼時候開始反映這些成長。
同樣的道理，當2027年真的進入大量交貨期，營收開始連續創高，我們反而要把目光放到2028年。
所以，我們追蹤法人預估值是否出現上下修，目的不只是知道公司明年會賺多少，而是要觀察市場對未來獲利的看法，正在往哪個方向改變。

paras_en: Investors often encounter a dilemma: a company’s revenue keeps breaking historical records, indicating strong industry demand, yet the stock price doesn’t always rise. Conversely, if a firm posts a revenue high this month but fails to top it next month, does that signal the end of growth and a cue to sell?

This issue actually touches on a crucial concept in investment research: a company’s revenue‑growth cycle and the market’s price cycle are not necessarily synchronized. The asynchrony stems from whether the market can anticipate the event in advance.

Especially in the semiconductor‑equipment sector, the gap between a customer’s decision to expand capacity, the equipment maker receiving an order, and the eventual delivery, acceptance and revenue recognition can span several quarters. Thus, once the market knows how much capacity a customer plans to build, the timing and amount of future revenue are already set. When the equipment vendor finally enters the delivery phase, those revenues have been forecasted long ago, so the market naturally does not react to this "known" information.

Why does a revenue high trigger different stock reactions for equipment firms compared with other industries? If you want to grasp industry cycles, semiconductor‑equipment stocks are a textbook example. Why?

Because building a semiconductor fab takes a long time. From a customer’s expansion decision, through the equipment maker’s order receipt, to final delivery, acceptance and revenue booking, the process can exceed a year. After such lengthy preparation, once the plant is ready and machines are installed en masse, the equipment supplier enters an intensive delivery phase, and revenue can surge within a few quarters, often setting new historical peaks.

However, when the current wave of equipment installations is complete, procurement demand can drop sharply. Unless the customer continues to expand existing lines or a new fab is slated for equipment, the supplier must wait for the next order wave.

Consequently, you’ll notice a distinct pattern in semiconductor‑equipment: long preparation periods up front, followed by a few quarters of concentrated deliveries, then a waiting period for the next expansion cycle.

This pronounced cyclicality explains why semiconductor‑equipment stocks can be highly volatile, and why stock prices may already price in the risk of a forthcoming order slowdown even while revenue continues to climb.

From a discounted‑cash‑flow perspective, even if a company’s long‑term demand remains solid, once a revenue peak passes and the next profit growth wave is still far off, the waiting period becomes a risk—especially given semiconductor cycles that exceed a year and the sizable order‑book uncertainty.

Case study: Wan‑Run’s 2023‑2024 revenue‑growth cycle. Take the advanced‑packaging CoWoS equipment maker Wan‑Run (6187‑TW). By looking at the ratio of contract liabilities to revenue—where contract liabilities represent customer pre‑payments (often called deposits)—a high ratio signals that current revenue (delivered units) is low while future order value (to be delivered) is high. This serves as a leading indicator of a large order influx, pinpointed around Q2 2023 in the chart below.

In other words, investors could have known in 2023 that 2024 would see strong growth, and analysts could already estimate the magnitude because semiconductor manufacturers plan capex well in advance. Since equipment suppliers cannot be swapped at the last minute, there is little uncertainty, making it reasonable for the stock to react ahead of earnings—not speculation. The closer the recognition date, the stronger the catalyst and the more pronounced the price move.
Let’s examine how long the gap can be from order receipt to actual delivery and revenue recognition.

Back in Q2 2023, Wan‑Run’s contract liabilities showed a clear order signal. After receiving orders, the company needed to stock parts, as illustrated in the chart; indeed, between the second half of 2023 and the first half of 2024, it built up a substantial inventory of components for future shipments.

However, revenue from that order wave didn’t materialize until the second half of 2024, more than a year later, when deliveries began converting into actual sales and profit. This timeline lets us see when the stock price started reflecting the growth.

It’s evident that after the Q2 2023 order signal, Wan‑Run’s share price already surged. The most pronounced rally occurred in 2024, the year of massive equipment deliveries and rapid revenue acceleration.

You’ll notice that when revenue truly ramps up, the stock continues to rise but at a slower pace. Once the supplier enters the heavy‑delivery, revenue‑recognition quarter, the price peaks and then reverses.
One timing nuance: monthly revenue is typically reported in the following month, so by the time investors see a revenue high in the financial statements, the stock may have already priced it in.

What operational insight can we draw? Align the trading cycle with visibility. When an industry takes a year or more from order to revenue, analysts should extend their horizon to an annual basis to anticipate stock‑price cycles early.
Why? Because the market can estimate, a year in advance, how much revenue will be recognized and when, based on customers’ expansion plans and equipment orders.
Therefore, when researching such stocks, you shouldn’t chase monthly revenue spikes. For investors who position early, the month when revenue peaks may actually signal the start of a selling window.

That’s why, in long‑cycle industries, it’s essential to monitor institutional forecasts for next‑year revenue and EPS, and whether those estimates are being revised upward or downward. This metric helps bridge a critical information gap; if all institutions already know next year’s demand and shipment volume, anyone still guessing will be far behind the market.

For example, if an equipment maker lands a large order in 2026 but expects deliveries to concentrate in 2027, the focus in 2026 should be on the projected 2027 revenue and EPS growth, not merely whether the current month’s revenue set a record.
The same logic applies when 2027 arrives and deliveries surge, pushing revenue to new highs; at that point, attention should shift to 2028.
Thus, tracking whether institutional forecasts are being revised isn’t just about gauging next year’s earnings—it’s about observing how the market’s outlook on future profitability is evolving.

items.title: 〈焦點股〉CCL報價漲、外資調高目標價 南亞盤中奔漲停
items.title_en: Focus Stock: CCL Prices Rise, Foreign Investors Raise Target Price; Nanya Soars Mid‑day to Upper Limit
paras: 台股今(21)日展開大反攻，南亞(1303-TW)受惠於中國銅箔基板(CCL)龍頭廠建滔傳出已向客戶發出漲價通知，加上AI伺服器需求持續升溫、高階玻璃纖維布供應吃緊，外資麥格理、瑞銀均調升南亞目標價，激勵南亞今日開高走高，盤中觸及漲停價325.5元，站上5日、10日均線，單日成交量也已連續7個交易日突破10萬張。
外資瑞銀證券及麥格理證券均看好南亞後市，認為南亞在CCL業務的產品毛利率優於預期，加上轉投資的南亞科(2408-TW)、台塑化(6505-TW)可望挹注獲利，紛紛調升南亞目標價至390元以上。
此外，根據建滔發出的通知，玻纖布市場需求旺盛，上游高階玻璃纖維布及玻璃紗供應緊張，10月玻纖布價格漲幅超過10%，以玻纖布為生產原料的上游產品，銷售價格也調漲15%。
法人表示，南亞受惠於AI基礎建設強勢擴張，持續強化電子材料高階產品的開發與認證，並著眼於電子材料、IC載板、CCL及上游記憶體等領域的供需變化，持續推進高階材料布局。法人樂觀看待高階銅箔基板需求成長，認為產業需求可望持續暢旺至2030年。
南亞目前在CCL高階材料升級方面，已進入產品驗證與出貨並行階段，HVLP4供應逐步穩定，M7、M8規格CCL已出貨，M9、M10則進入客戶認證階段，其中M10最快有望於明(2027)年上半年取得客戶初步認證。
展望第4季，南亞先前預期，10月及第4季業績有望持續攀升，第4季營運可望優於第3季，全年營收有機會再創歷史新高，公司對明年展望也相當樂觀。
paras_en: Taiwan stocks launched a strong counter‑attack today (the 21st), with Nanya (1303‑TW) benefiting from a price‑increase notice issued by CCL leader Jiantao to its customers. Coupled with sustained heating demand for AI servers and tight supply of high‑end glass fiber cloth, foreign investors Macquarie and UBS both raised Nanya’s target price, spurring the stock to open higher and climb, hitting the daily limit of NT$325.5, breaking above the 5‑day and 10‑day moving averages, and its daily volume has now exceeded 100,000 shares for seven consecutive trading days.

Foreign investors UBS Securities and Macquarie Securities are both bullish on Nanya’s outlook, believing its product gross margin in the CCL business exceeds expectations. In addition, its affiliates Nanya Technology (2408‑TW) and Formosa Plastics Corp. (6505‑TW) are expected to contribute earnings, prompting them to lift Nanya’s target price to above NT$390.

Moreover, according to Jiantao’s notice, demand for glass fiber cloth is robust, and upstream supplies of high‑end glass fiber cloth and glass yarn are tight. In October, glass fiber cloth prices rose more than 10%, and upstream products that use the cloth as raw material saw sales prices increase by 15%.

Institutional investors said Nanya is benefiting from the strong expansion of AI infrastructure, continuously strengthening the development and certification of high‑end electronic material products, and focusing on supply‑demand shifts in electronic materials, IC substrates, CCL and upstream memory sectors, while advancing its high‑end material layout. They are optimistic about growth in high‑end copper foil substrate demand, expecting industry demand to remain vigorous through 2030.

Nanya is currently in the product verification and shipment phase for upgrading high‑end CCL materials. HVLP4 supply is gradually stabilizing, M7 and M8‑spec CCL have been shipped, while M9 and M10 are in customer certification stages, with M10 potentially receiving initial customer certification as early as the first half of 2027.

Looking ahead to Q4, Nanya previously projected that October and Q4 performance would continue to rise, with Q4 operations expected to outperform Q3. Full‑year revenue could set a new historical high, and the company is also very optimistic about its outlook for next year.

items.title: AI熱潮推升大立光等科技業布局台中 產業園區工業地產最搶手
items.title_en: AI Boom Boosts Tech Companies' Expansion in Taichung; Industrial Real Estate in Parks Most In‑Demand
paras: 美光中科后里園區的先進封裝測試二廠日前啟用，台積電(2330-TW)中科擴建二期新廠也預計自2027年起陸續完工投產。除了美光、台積電外，上市櫃科技業者也積極布局台中，截至今年第三季，已有8家企業在台中購廠、購地，其中以大立光(3008-TW)出手最大，陸續購入台中產業園區、精密機械科技園區等地的7座廠房，合計斥資超過80.8億元。
此外，志聖(2467-TW)、信邦(3023-TW)、萬潤(6187-TW)、鴻勁(7769-TW)、創新服務(7828-TW)等半導體相關業者，也分別在精密機械科技園區、台中港、大雅、大甲等地布局，8家科技業者合計投入逾130億元，購入超過3萬坪產業用地，顯示台中在AI產業發展帶動下，持續吸引科技業者進駐。
台灣房屋集團趨勢中心資深經理陳定中表示，近年AI熱潮帶動科技業快速發展，半導體、伺服器、高階製造、光元件、自動化設備及精密加工等領域的需求均快速成長。台中本身擁有完整的精密機械聚落及金屬加工供應鏈，加上美光、台積電等大廠持續擴大中科園區布局，吸引相關科技產業進駐，有助於上下游廠商緊密整合，也可運用台中位居台灣中部的地理優勢，串聯陸海空交通及物流網絡，進一步提升企業進駐意願。
觀察企業投資台中的區段，以台中產業園區最受青睞，單是大立光就購入5座廠房，萬潤、頌勝(7768-TW)、崴寶精密(7744-TW)也都選擇在台中產業園區布局。
陳定中指出，台中產業園區位於中科台中園區與精密機械科技園區之間，可提供企業從基礎零件到高階技術的產業支援，加上周邊交通網絡完善，鄰近台74線、國道1號及國道3號，距離台中港、台中國際機場也不遠，與七期商貿中心僅一橋之隔，兼具廠區生產、產品運輸及商務往來等需求，成為科技大廠拓展版圖的熱門選擇。
台灣房屋七期單元特許加盟店店東陳裕方表示，由中科、台中產業園區及精密機械科技園區構成的大肚山產業走廊，是台中招商引資的熱點。周邊環繞中科水堀頭、單元一、嶺東文山、龍井東海及沙鹿新光田等五大商圈，隨著園區發展帶動就業人口增加，未來可望吸引自住需求進場，帶動周邊房市發展。
陳裕方指出，五大商圈中，中科水堀頭商圈聯外交通最便利，加上捷運藍線建設話題，新案高價已來到7、8字頭，與低密度開發的單元一別墅區同屬高總價區段，未來較有機會吸引產業高階主管及企業主青睞。
至於嶺東文山、龍井東海及沙鹿新光田，目前新案平均單價普遍落在4字頭，產品則以2、3房、總價較低的小宅為主，較符合園區基層就業族群的購屋需求。
paras_en: Micron’s advanced packaging test second factory in the Houcheng (Houli) park was recently inaugurated, and TSMC (2330‑TW) plans to complete its Phase‑2 expansion of the Central Taiwan Science Park (CTSP) plant starting in 2027. In addition to Micron and TSMC, listed tech firms are actively setting up in Taichung; by the third quarter of this year, eight companies have bought factories or land there, with Largan Precision (3008‑TW) making the biggest move, acquiring seven factories in the Taichung Industrial Park, the Precision Machinery Science Park and other sites, spending more than NT$8.08 billion.

In addition, semiconductor‑related firms such as Zhi‑Sheng (2467‑TW), Xinbang (3023‑TW), Wan‑Run (6187‑TW), Hong‑Jin (7769‑TW) and Innovation Services (7828‑TW) have each set up operations in the Precision Machinery Science Park, Taichung Port, Daya and Dajia. The eight tech companies together have invested over NT$13 billion and bought more than 30,000 ping of industrial land, showing that Taichung continues to attract tech players as AI‑driven industry growth accelerates.

Chen Ding‑zhong, senior manager at the Trend Center of Taiwan Housing Group, said the recent AI surge has spurred rapid growth in the tech sector, with soaring demand for semiconductors, servers, advanced manufacturing, optoelectronic components, automation equipment and precision machining. Taichung already boasts a complete precision‑machinery cluster and metal‑processing supply chain, and the continued expansion of major players such as Micron and TSMC in the CTSP draws related industries, facilitating tight upstream‑downstream integration and leveraging Taichung’s central location to link land, sea and air transport and logistics networks, further boosting corporate interest.

Looking at where firms invest in Taichung, the Taichung Industrial Park is the most popular. Largan alone bought five factories there, while Wan‑Run, Song‑Sheng (7768‑TW) and Wei‑Bao Precision (7744‑TW) also chose the Taichung Industrial Park for their sites.

Chen noted that the Taichung Industrial Park sits between the CTSP and the Precision Machinery Science Park, offering companies support from basic components to high‑end technologies. Its surrounding transport network is well‑developed, with easy access to Provincial Highway 74, National Freeways 1 and 3, and it is close to Taichung Port and Taichung International Airport. It is also just across a bridge from the Qiqi Commercial Center, meeting needs for production, product shipping and business interaction, making it a hot choice for large tech firms expanding their footprints.

Chen Yu‑fang, franchise owner of a Taiwan Housing branch in the Qiqi district, said the Da‑du‑Shan industrial corridor—formed by the CTSP, Taichung Industrial Park and the Precision Machinery Science Park—is a hotspot for investment in Taichung. The area is surrounded by five major commercial zones: CTSP Shuikou‑Tou, Unit 1, Ling‑Dong Wenshan, Long‑Jing Donghai and Shalu Xinguangtian. As the parks develop and employment rises, residential demand is expected to grow, spurring the surrounding housing market.

Chen added that among the five commercial zones, the CTSP Shuikou‑Tou area enjoys the best external transport links. With the upcoming MRT Blue Line, new projects are already fetching high‑seven‑digit prices, comparable to the low‑density villa area of Unit 1, placing both in the high‑total‑price segment and likely to attract senior industry executives and business owners in the future.

As for Ling‑Dong Wenshan, Long‑Jing Donghai and Shalu Xinguangtian, current new‑project average prices generally sit in the four‑digit‑thousands range, offering mainly two‑ or three‑room small homes at lower total prices, which better match the home‑buying needs of the parks’ rank‑and‑file workers.
