items.title: 川普金主選前2周開砲：共和黨去年減稅是錯的　川普對盟友關稅戰是「災難」
items.title_en: Trump's Backer Fires Shots Two Weeks Before Election: GOP's 2023 Tax Cut Was a Mistake, Trump's Tariff War with Allies a "Disaster"
paras: 美國期中選舉倒數2周之際，城堡投資執行長Ken Griffin認為共和黨前景堪憂，並稱川普與美國盟友的爭鬥是問題的一部分。
Griffin週二(20日)在紐約舉行的「全球市場未來大會」(Future of Global Markets Conference)上說，共和黨期中大選選情艱難，川普關稅政策加劇了通膨，並擾亂了供應鏈。
他說：「我認為與加拿大、歐洲及我們的盟友之間的關稅戰簡直是場災難，川普在總統任期剛開始這麼做時我就談過這一點。坦率地說，我不願意這麼說，但我當時是對的。這助長了通膨。這肯定切斷了全球供應鏈。」
今年7月20日，美國總統川普宣布對部分加拿大進口商品加徵50%的關稅，理由是歧視美國汽車、酒類和乳製品出口。這些關稅已於8月生效。
美國9月消費者物價指數(CPI)年增3.7%，而自川普重返白宮以來，通膨幾乎抹去了一班勞工的時薪漲幅。燃料可負擔性和住房供應不足已成為共和黨在期中選舉中的痛點。
Griffin預測，共和黨幾乎肯定會失去對國會至少一院的控制權，並將期中選舉描述為對執政黨的制衡。「眾議院幾乎處於非常艱難的境地，而參議院的選情將非常膠著。」
他還指出，去年美國進一步減稅，是美國國會共和黨人和總統川普犯下的錯誤，美國政府在疫情期間花了很多錢，「我們並沒有延續減稅政策的財政空間」。美國債務已突破40兆美元。
Griffin認為，與增加支出相比，共和黨人過去兩年在減稅一事上問題更大。
他還對川普對伊朗戰爭的解釋有自己的看法，並稱川普政府對待移民的方式「可恥」。「伊朗戰爭非常不受歡迎。我認為他在解釋原因方面做得非常糟糕，我認為總統沒有以有力、有意義的方式向美國人民說明這一點。」
Griffin也指出，他認為應加強邊境安全，但對於已經在這裡的移民，應為他們提供「成為我們社會有貢獻成員的途徑，並幫助發展我們的經濟」。
paras_en: As the U.S. midterm election countdown reaches two weeks, Citadel CEO Ken Griffin says the Republican outlook looks bleak and describes Trump’s disputes with U.S. allies as part of the problem.

Griffin told the Future of Global Markets Conference in New York on Tuesday, the 20th, that the GOP’s midterm prospects are tough, that Trump’s tariff policy has worsened inflation and disrupted supply chains.

He said, “I think the tariff war with Canada, Europe and our allies is a disaster. I warned about this when Trump started his presidency. Frankly, I don’t like saying it, but I was right. It has fed inflation and definitely cut off global supply chains.”
On July 20 this year, President Trump announced a 50% tariff on certain Canadian imports, citing discrimination against U.S. auto, alcohol and dairy exports. The tariffs took effect in August.

U.S. consumer prices rose 3.7% year‑over‑year in September, and since Trump returned to the White House, inflation has almost erased wage gains for many workers. Fuel affordability and a shortage of housing have become pain points for Republicans in the midterms.

Griffin predicts the GOP will almost certainly lose control of at least one chamber of Congress and describes the midterms as a check on the party in power. “The House is in a very tough spot, and the Senate race will be extremely tight,” he said.

He also noted that last year’s further tax cuts were a mistake by Republican lawmakers and Trump, adding that the government spent heavily during the pandemic and “we have no fiscal space to keep cutting taxes.” U.S. debt has now topped $40 trillion.
Griffin argues that, compared with increased spending, the GOP’s tax‑cut agenda over the past two years is the bigger problem.

He offered his own take on Trump’s handling of the war with Iran, calling the administration’s immigration approach “shameful.” “The Iran war is very unpopular. He explained it terribly, and the president failed to communicate the reasons to the American people in a strong, meaningful way,” he said.
Griffin also said he supports stronger border security, but for migrants already here, the U.S. should provide “a path to become contributing members of our society and help grow our economy.”

items.title: Sony出售逾400項XR專利給Meta  這對蘋果Vision Pro遊戲來說是個問題
items.title_en: Sony Sells Over 400 XR Patents to Meta, Raising Concerns for Apple Vision Pro Gaming
paras: 全球虛擬實境(VR)市場再傳震撼異動！科技媒體《AppleInsider》指出，日本科技巨擘 Sony(SONY-US)已正式將旗下多達 419 件延展實境(XR)相關專利移轉給 Meta(META-US)。隨著 Sony 旗下的 PlayStation VR2(PS VR2)裝置與控制器近來頻傳停產、市面供貨極度吃緊，這筆交易不僅引發外界對 Sony 是否將逐步淡出 VR 硬體市場的猜測，更意外對蘋果(AAPL-US)Vision Pro 的遊戲生態布局投下一枚不確定炸彈。
這起專利交易最早由韓國媒體《ZDNet Korea》披露，隨後由 VR 專業媒體《Road to VR》引述報導。雙方於 2025 年 12 月簽署專利移轉確認協議，涵蓋 180 件美國專利，以及在日本、中國、南韓、歐洲等地提出的 239 件同族專利申請，技術範圍包括 XR 應用運算處理、頭戴式顯示器設計及相關硬體。
《ZDNet Korea》10 月 5 日報導指出，當時美國專利商標局紀錄顯示，已有 43 件美國專利於今年 6 至 9 月分批登錄移轉至 Meta。Sony 與 Meta 均未公開宣布交易細節，Sony 也未說明未來 VR 硬體布局。
PS VR2 近月供貨吃緊，市場並傳出頭戴裝置與控制器已停止生產。
不過，《AppleInsider》引用的《GamesRadar+》報導明確指出，PlayStation 尚未證實 PS VR2 停產，因此仍不能據此認定 Sony 將退出 VR 硬體市場。
這項發展之所以牽動蘋果，在於 Vision Pro 已透過 visionOS 26 加入對 PS VR2 Sense 控制器的支援。
蘋果自 2025 年 11 月 11 日起，在美國官方線上商店販售控制器與充電座套裝，售價為 249.95 美元。
Vision Pro 原本以眼球追蹤與手勢操作為主要互動方式，但許多 VR 遊戲依賴手持控制器。加入 PS VR2 Sense 支援後，玩家可使用六自由度動作追蹤、手指觸碰偵測與震動功能，拓展 Vision Pro 的沉浸式遊戲體驗。
《AppleInsider》分析，這筆專利交易目前對 Vision Pro 的主要疑慮在於控制器後續供應。若 Sony 未來停止供應相關配件，現有庫存又逐步耗盡，可能增加新用戶取得控制器的難度，並為蘋果拓展 VR 遊戲帶來挑戰。
蘋果可能的因應方向包括擴大第三方 VR 控制器支援，或與其他遊戲硬體業者合作。
Vision Pro 雖已支援多款傳統遊戲手把，但對需要追蹤手部位置與動作的沉浸式遊戲而言，VR 控制器仍有其用途。
自行開發也是報導提出的可能選項。
9 月曝光的系統程式碼線索顯示，蘋果可能正在開發兩款遊戲控制器，但相關設計偏向傳統類型，尚無法確認是否將推出 Vision Pro 專用 VR 控制器。上述方向仍屬媒體分析，蘋果尚未公布相關計畫。
paras_en: The global virtual reality (VR) market is shaking again. Tech outlet AppleInsider reports that Japanese tech giant Sony (SONY-US) has officially transferred a total of 419 extended reality (XR)‑related patents to Meta (META-US). With Sony’s PlayStation VR2 (PS VR2) headset and controllers recently rumored to be discontinued and supply extremely tight, the deal has sparked speculation that Sony may be gradually exiting the VR hardware market and has unexpectedly thrown an uncertainty bomb into Apple’s (AAPL-US) Vision Pro gaming ecosystem.

The patent deal was first disclosed by South Korea’s ZDNet Korea and later cited by VR‑focused site Road to VR. The parties signed a patent‑transfer agreement in December 2025 covering 180 U.S. patents and 239 family‑patent applications filed in Japan, China, South Korea, Europe and elsewhere, spanning XR application processing, headset design and related hardware.

ZDNet Korea reported on October 5 that the U.S. Patent and Trademark Office records show 43 U.S. patents were logged for transfer to Meta in batches between June and September of this year. Neither Sony nor Meta has released details of the transaction, and Sony has not commented on its future VR hardware strategy.
PS VR2 supply has been tight in recent weeks, and market chatter suggests the headset and its controllers have already stopped production.
However, AppleInsider cites a GamesRadar+ report that PlayStation has not confirmed a PS VR2 shutdown, so it cannot yet be concluded that Sony is exiting the VR hardware market.
The development matters to Apple because Vision Pro, via visionOS 26, now supports the PS VR2 Sense controller.
Since November 11 2025, Apple has been selling a controller‑and‑charging‑dock bundle on its U.S. online store for $249.95.

Vision Pro originally relied on eye‑tracking and hand‑gesture interaction, but many VR games depend on handheld controllers. With PS VR2 Sense support, users can enjoy six‑degree‑of‑freedom motion tracking, finger‑touch detection and haptic feedback, expanding Vision Pro’s immersive gaming experience.

AppleInsider analyses that the main concern for Vision Pro from this patent deal is the future supply of the controller. If Sony stops providing the accessories and existing inventory dwindles, new users may find it harder to obtain the controller, posing a challenge for Apple’s VR gaming expansion.
Apple could respond by broadening third‑party VR controller support or partnering with other gaming‑hardware companies.
Although Vision Pro already supports several traditional gamepads, VR controllers remain important for immersive titles that require hand‑position and motion tracking.
In‑house development is another option mentioned in the report.

A September leak of system code hints that Apple may be working on two game controllers, but the designs lean toward conventional styles, and it is unclear whether a Vision Pro‑specific VR controller will be released. These ideas are still media speculation; Apple has not announced any related plans.

items.title: 全球資金撤離AI股後到哪去了？富達：A股科技股處磨底階段　AI應用端將誕生「百倍股」
items.title_en: Where Did Global Capital Flow After Exiting AI Stocks? Fidelity: A-Share Tech Stocks Are in a Bottom‑Polishing Phase, AI Applications May Yield "Hundred‑Fold" Stocks
paras: 全球AI股近一個月遭集中拋售，地緣政治與宏觀風險升溫下，市場對OpenAI、Anthropic等模型公司估值產生質疑，A股科技股亦呈「美股映射」式劇烈波動。對此富達基金經理聶毅翔指出，A股科技股前期下跌主因交易擁擠與資金流出，基本面未明顯惡化，但短期波動加劇，左側抄底難度大，中長期仍看好AI前景，認為相比已大漲的基礎設施，應用端更可能誕生「百倍股」。
談及模型估值爭議，聶毅翔表示，牛市看天花板如市銷率，熊市看現金流。高利率環境壓制成長股，是AI標的走弱關鍵。

他並以SpaceX為例，該公司上市估值1.77兆美元但仍淨虧損，早期交易風險高，禁售期後拋壓大，大模型估值同樣難用傳統模型衡量，依賴技術革命信念。若Anthropic等年度經常性收入(ARR)保持高速成長，遠期估值可被消化，但關鍵在成長確定性與利率走向。此外，當前地緣政治摩擦與高油價推升美國升息機率，美國9月CPI年增3.7%，核心CPI升至2.6%，雙超預期，市場對Fed升息押注升溫，利率敏感型科技股承壓明顯。
聶毅翔認為，AI發展類似2000年網路泡沫後的早期階段，短期市場消化估值後，下一步重點轉向應用。相比基礎設施，應用端更可能誕生「百倍股」，但大模型公司也在向下做應用，如智能體和辦公工具，曾導致軟體股大跌。
他指出，真正有潛力的應用公司需具備兩大特徵：擁有獨有數據或場景(如醫療、法律、金融等垂直領域)，且毛利率能扛住推理成本。投資應用落地比在基建高位追高更具性價比，但需要極大確信度與耐心。
A股方面，聶毅翔指出下跌主因交易擁擠和資金流出，今年Q3財報顯示基本面依然強勁，但新增資金觀望。A股雖處於降息環境，但科技股高度映射美股利息週期和地緣情緒，波動加劇，「殺估值」持續多久難判斷，目前仍處「磨底階段」。
對於光模組等標的，聶毅翔稱產業基本面強勁，算力成長帶動光模組需求非線性上升，但殺估值過程中負面消息易被放大，例如近期某法律團隊傳出的「65%美國含量」規則導致大跌，該消息並非FCC正式討論的規則。光模組物料成本中DSP和光芯片以美系、日系為主，中國國內組裝廠滿足該比例並非難事，但下行期間市場情緒脆弱，負面情緒被擴大。
半導體方面，中國自給率上升是確定長期趨勢，設備受益於國產替代。中國企業在光模組領域具全球競爭力，資本開支拐點看台積電、艾司摩爾等上游訂單，目前訂單飽滿，說明下游需求強勁，尚未出現產能過剩。
交易策略上，聶毅翔建議右側確認優於左側抄底，左側難以精準捕捉最低點，易導致持續浮虧和贖回壓力。右側結合基本面、技術面與市場信號，在趨勢相對確定後介入，雖可能錯過底部10%-20%漲幅，但能確保買入即獲利，形成安全墊。關鍵是區分「頂部」與「早期右側」，避免在情緒狂熱時接盤。
paras_en: Global AI stocks have faced concentrated selling over the past month. Amid rising geopolitical and macro risks, the market is questioning the valuations of model companies such as OpenAI and Anthropic, and A‑share technology stocks have shown the same dramatic, "U.S.‑stock‑mirrored" volatility. Fidelity fund manager Nie Yixiang said the earlier decline in A‑share tech stocks was mainly due to crowded trading and capital outflows; fundamentals have not noticeably deteriorated, but short‑term volatility has intensified, making left‑side bottom‑fishing difficult. He remains bullish on AI in the medium to long term and believes that, compared with the already soaring infrastructure sector, the application side is more likely to produce "hundred‑fold" stocks.

Discussing the valuation debate for models, Nie Yixiang noted that in a bull market investors look at ceiling metrics like price‑to‑sales, while in a bear market they focus on cash flow. A high‑interest‑rate environment suppresses growth stocks and is a key reason for the weakness in AI targets.

He cited SpaceX as an example: the company’s market valuation at IPO was $1.77 trillion despite still posting net losses, making early‑stage trading risky and leading to heavy selling pressure after lock‑up periods. Valuations of large models are similarly hard to gauge with traditional models and rely on belief in a technological revolution. If companies like Anthropic maintain rapid growth in annual recurring revenue (ARR), their long‑term valuations could be justified, but the key factors are growth certainty and the direction of interest rates. Moreover, current geopolitical frictions and high oil prices have raised the probability of U.S. rate hikes; U.S. CPI for September rose 3.7% year‑on‑year, core CPI to 2.6%, both well above expectations, prompting the market to bet more aggressively on Fed tightening, which has put pressure on rate‑sensitive tech stocks.

Nie Yixiang believes AI development is akin to the early stage after the 2000 internet bubble: after short‑term market digestion of valuations, the focus will shift to applications. Compared with infrastructure, the application side is more likely to generate "hundred‑fold" stocks, though large‑model firms are also moving down‑the‑stack into applications such as agents and office tools, which have previously caused software stocks to tumble.

He pointed out that truly promising application companies need two key traits: exclusive data or scenarios (e.g., verticals like healthcare, legal, finance) and gross margins that can absorb inference costs. Investing in applied roll‑outs offers better risk‑adjusted returns than chasing high‑priced infrastructure stocks, but it requires strong conviction and patience.

Regarding A‑shares, Nie Yixiang said the decline was driven by crowded trading and capital outflows. Q3 earnings this year show fundamentals remain robust, yet new capital is cautious. Although A‑shares are in a rate‑cut environment, tech stocks are highly correlated with U.S. interest‑rate cycles and geopolitical sentiment, amplifying volatility. How long the "valuation‑killing" phase will last is hard to judge, and the market is still in a "bottom‑polishing" stage.

On optical‑module stocks, Nie Yixiang said the industry fundamentals are strong; growth in computing power drives a non‑linear rise in demand for optical modules. However, during the valuation‑cutting process, negative news can be amplified—for example, a recent rumor from a legal team about a "65% U.S. content" rule caused a sharp drop, even though the rule is not an official FCC proposal. The material costs for optical modules, such as DSPs and optical chips, are dominated by U.S. and Japanese suppliers; Chinese domestic assemblers can meet the required ratios, but market sentiment is fragile in downtrends, magnifying negative emotions.

In semiconductors, China’s rising self‑sufficiency rate is a clear long‑term trend, benefiting equipment as domestic substitutes grow. Chinese firms are globally competitive in optical modules, and capital‑expenditure turning points are linked to upstream orders from TSMC, ASML and others. Current orders are full, indicating strong downstream demand and no sign of overcapacity yet.

For trading strategy, Nie Yixiang recommends right‑side confirmation over left‑side bottom‑fishing. The left side is hard to pinpoint the exact low, often leading to sustained floating losses and redemption pressure. The right side combines fundamentals, technicals and market signals, entering after the trend is relatively certain. While this may miss the first 10%‑20% upside from the bottom, it ensures buying at profit and creates a safety cushion. The key is to distinguish between a "top" and an "early right side" and avoid taking positions during emotional frenzies.

items.title: AI從生成文字走向實體世界 ASI募資3.25億美元擴張關鍵基礎設施 估值達30億美元
items.title_en: AI Moves From Text Generation to the Physical World: ASI Raises $325 Million to Expand Critical Infrastructure, Valued at $3 Billion
paras:
在生成式AI吸走絕大多數創投資金的此刻,把AI用在實體世界關鍵基建的公司正以更快的速度兌現估值。

美國人工智慧新創公司ASI完成3.25億美元C輪融資，公司估值一舉升至30億美元，躋身獨角獸企業行列。這家前身為Air Space Intelligence的波士頓新創，主要開發用於空中交通、電力網路及軍事行動的AI模擬與監控系統，協助營運人員預測未來數小時、數天甚至數周可能發生的狀況，提前因應壅塞、供電需求變化及軍事後勤等複雜問題。隨著AI投資逐漸從生成文字與影像，擴展至航空、能源及國防等實體產業，ASI也成為資金積極追逐的關鍵基礎設施AI業者之一。

本輪融資由Spark Capital領投，參與投資的機構包括Citadel Securities關係企業、Meritech Capital、Craft Ventures、Energy Impact Partners及創投公司Andreessen Horowitz (a16z) 等。ASI表示，新資金將用於擴大能源、物流及軍事領域的系統部署，並強化位於波士頓的研究與工程團隊，持續提升AI模型對複雜實體系統的模擬、預測及最佳化能力。
ASI的技術與一般生成式AI有所不同。生成式AI主要根據訓練資料產生文字、影像或其他內容，ASI則透過持續模擬實體系統的運作，分析不同情境下可能出現的結果，協助人類在問題發生前採取行動。公司結合機率式預測與確定性模型，讓營運人員不只掌握最可能發生的情況，也能評估特定條件下系統可能如何變化，應用範圍涵蓋空中交通管理、電網調度、國防指揮及後勤規劃。
航空領域是ASI目前的重要業務之一。公司與美國交通部及聯邦航空總署 (FAA) 合作，運用AI系統模擬飛機航線、即時空中交通、天候變化及航空管制人力等因素，預測可能出現的航班壅塞，並提出調整航線或營運安排的方案，以降低延誤、提升航空安全與空域使用效率。
今年6月，ASI取得美國交通部與FAA總值8.75億美元、為期12年的國家空域系統現代化計畫。這項合約將協助美國更新空中交通管理系統，規模與年限均為公司重要的商業里程碑。據《彭博》報導，ASI在競標中擊敗包括Palantir Technologies (PLTR-US) 及Thales在內的較大型競爭者。ASI也因此成為2000年以來，僅有的4家獲得此類大型聯邦計畫的科技公司之一。
FAA已於上月在華盛頓杜勒斯國際機場導入ASI軟體，未來計畫逐步擴展至美國主要機場。系統可整合航班路徑、即時空中交通、天氣與管制人力等資訊，協助航空管制人員提前辨識交通瓶頸，規劃更有效率的航班運行方式。對航空業而言，若能更準確地預測空域壅塞並及早調整安排，將有助減少延誤及相關營運成本。

ASI的航空客戶還包括達美航空 (Delta Air Lines) (DAL-US)、聯合航空 (United Airlines) (UAL-US) 及阿拉斯加航空 (Alaska Air Group) (ALK-US)。公司表示，其系統已用於協調這些航空公司的營運。除了航空公司外，ASI也拓展至能源產業，與美國國家電網相關企業National Grid合作，運用AI技術進行電網規劃與營運分析。National Grid為美國東北部超過2,000萬人提供天然氣及電力服務，隨著電力需求上升、電網負載增加，業者需要更精確地預測需求變化、天候衝擊與潛在供電瓶頸，這也成為ASI進一步拓展能源市場的切入點。
國防業務則是ASI另一項重要成長來源。公司10月宣布取得美國陸軍一份為期5年、總值9,900萬美元的合約，將提供AI軟體，支援陸軍現代化指揮與控制系統，包括次世代指揮與控制計畫 (Next Generation Command and Control, NGC2)。相關技術可協助軍方整合不同來源的作戰資訊、評估行動情境並改善指揮決策。
ASI也已將系統部署至美國陸軍、空軍及美國太平洋司令部等國防單位。公司表示，其平台在美國空軍的使用持續擴大，並曾於名為「Operation Epic Fury」的軍事行動期間支援超過4,000名操作人員。相關部署凸顯AI模擬系統在軍事指揮、作戰規劃及後勤協調方面的應用潛力，但實際成效仍取決於系統可靠性、資料品質，以及人員如何將預測結果納入決策流程。
ASI創辦人暨執行長Phillip Buckendorf表示，未來經濟成長將取決於管理關鍵基礎設施的人員，是否具備預測複雜系統變化的能力。他指出，科技產業過去投入大量資金訓練AI處理文字與生成內容，ASI則聚焦於能管理及控制實體資產的AI系統，涵蓋飛機、船舶及電力網路等領域。公司希望讓關鍵系統從問題發生後才被動處理，轉向事前模擬、預測與整體協調。

ASI總部設於波士頓，並在華盛頓特區、丹佛及歐洲設有據點。公司前身Air Space Intelligence於2024年將總部從矽谷遷往波士頓，並更名為ASI。根據《Boston Business Journal》報導，公司約有220名員工，其中約80人在波士頓總部工作；其他報導則指出，公司員工分布於美國不同地區及歐洲。新一輪資金將用於擴大研究與工程團隊，並加速能源、物流及軍事環境中的產品部署。
ASI此次以30億美元估值完成融資，反映投資人對能直接應用於實體經濟的AI技術興趣升溫。相較於聊天機器人等面向一般消費者的產品，空中交通、電網及軍事系統對可靠性與預測準確度有更高要求，導入流程也通常更複雜；但一旦系統成為關鍵營運流程的一部分，便可能建立長期客戶關係與持續性合約收入。
不過，政府大型合約與高估值並不代表公司已經確保獲利。ASI仍須持續證明其系統能在高度複雜、容錯空間有限的環境中穩定運作，也必須將大型合約轉化為實際部署與持續收入。未來公司能否擴大能源及物流市場、深化國防合作，並在不同產業複製其技術模式，將是衡量這輪融資能否帶動長期成長的重要指標。
paras_en: At a time when generative AI is soaking up the bulk of venture capital, companies applying AI to critical physical‑world infrastructure are achieving valuations at an even faster pace.

Boston‑based AI startup ASI, formerly Air Space Intelligence, completed a $325 million Series C round that lifted its valuation to $3 billion, making it a unicorn. The company builds AI simulation and monitoring systems for air traffic, power grids and military operations, helping operators forecast conditions hours, days or weeks ahead and proactively address congestion, power‑demand shifts and complex logistics challenges. As AI investment expands from text and image generation into aviation, energy and defense, ASI has become a hot target for capital as a key infrastructure AI provider.

ASI’s technology differs from typical generative AI. While generative models produce text, images or other content from training data, ASI continuously simulates the operation of physical systems, analyzing possible outcomes under various scenarios so humans can act before problems arise. By blending probabilistic forecasts with deterministic models, operators not only see the most likely future but can also evaluate how systems might behave under specific conditions, covering air‑traffic management, grid dispatch, defense command and logistics planning.

Aviation is one of ASI’s core businesses. The firm works with the U.S. Department of Transportation and the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) to simulate flight routes, real‑time air traffic, weather changes and controller staffing, predicting potential flight‑path congestion and recommending route or schedule adjustments to reduce delays, improve safety and increase airspace efficiency.

In June, ASI secured a $875 million, 12‑year national airspace system modernization contract with the DOT and FAA. The deal will help modernize U.S. air‑traffic management and marks a major commercial milestone for the company. Bloomberg reported that ASI beat larger rivals such as Palantir Technologies (PLTR‑US) and Thales in the bid, making it one of only four tech firms since 2000 to win a federal project of this scale.

The FAA deployed ASI software at Washington Dulles International Airport last month and plans to roll it out across major U.S. airports. The system integrates flight paths, real‑time traffic, weather and controller staffing data to help controllers spot bottlenecks early and plan more efficient flight operations. More accurate congestion forecasts and early adjustments could cut delays and related operating costs for airlines.

ASI’s airline customers also include Delta Air Lines (DAL‑US), United Airlines (UAL‑US) and Alaska Air Group (ALK‑US). The company says its platform is already being used to coordinate these carriers’ operations. Beyond airlines, ASI is expanding into energy, partnering with National Grid, a U.S. utility serving over 20 million people in the Northeast, to apply AI to grid planning and operational analysis as demand, load and weather‑related challenges grow.

Defense is another key growth engine for ASI. In October the firm announced a five‑year, $99 million contract with the U.S. Army to provide AI software supporting modernized command‑and‑control systems, including the Next Generation Command and Control (NGC2) program. The technology helps the military fuse disparate operational data, evaluate scenarios and improve decision‑making.

ASI has also deployed its platform to U.S. Army, Air Force and U.S. Pacific Command units. The company notes that usage within the Air Force is expanding and that the system supported over 4,000 personnel during a mission called “Operation Epic Fury.” These deployments highlight AI simulation’s potential for military command, planning and logistics, though actual impact depends on system reliability, data quality and how users incorporate predictions into decisions.

Founder and CEO Phillip Buckendorf said future economic growth will hinge on whether those who manage critical infrastructure can predict complex system changes. He noted that the tech sector has poured money into training AI for text and content generation, whereas ASI focuses on AI that manages and controls physical assets such as aircraft, ships and power grids, aiming to shift from reactive problem‑solving to proactive simulation, forecasting and coordination.

ASI is headquartered in Boston with additional offices in Washington, D.C., Denver and Europe. The company, originally Air Space Intelligence, moved its headquarters from Silicon Valley to Boston in 2024 and rebranded as ASI. According to the Boston Business Journal, it employs roughly 220 people, about 80 of whom work at the Boston hub, with the rest spread across the U.S. and Europe. The new funding will expand research and engineering teams and accelerate product roll‑outs in energy, logistics and military settings.

The $3 billion valuation reflects growing investor interest in AI that can be applied directly to the real economy. Compared with consumer‑facing chatbots, air‑traffic, grid and defense systems demand higher reliability and forecast accuracy, and their adoption processes are more complex; however, once embedded in core operations, they can generate long‑term customer relationships and recurring contract revenue.

Nevertheless, large government contracts and a high valuation do not guarantee profitability. ASI must continue to prove its systems can operate stably in highly complex, low‑tolerance environments and convert big contracts into actual deployments and sustained revenue. Its ability to expand in energy and logistics, deepen defense partnerships and replicate its technology model across sectors will be key metrics for judging whether this financing round fuels long‑term growth.

items.title: Meta Q3財報考驗華爾街對AI支出的承受度
items.title_en: Meta Q3 Earnings Test Wall Street's Tolerance for AI Spending
paras: 《Yahoo Finance》報導，Meta(META-US)將於週三美股收盤後公布第三季財報，為科技巨頭的財報季揭開序幕。
根據彭博分析師共識預估，Meta第三季每股盈餘(EPS)預計為3.56美元，營收為633億美元，高於去年同期公布的每股盈餘1.05美元及營收512億美元。
然而，資本支出預計將年增117%，達410億美元。Meta旗下Reality Labs部門預計將出現52億美元的營業虧損。
Meta公布財報之際，AI投資人正對雲端運算公司CoreWeave(CRWV-US)的債務負擔感到憂慮，市場情緒在樂觀與擔心之間搖擺。
更令市場不安的是，Gartner上週發布報告指出，AI基礎設施業者預計到2030年將投入超過8.5兆美元，但消費者及企業AI營收合計可能僅達3.6兆美元。這可能導致「超過4兆美元的資產價值面臨減損風險，風險期間可能延續至2032年」。
過去一年，Meta股價下跌逾3%，原因之一是華爾街希望公司更清楚說明，如何將龐大的支出轉化為營收與獲利。
不過，這家社群媒體巨頭近幾週也傳出多項利多。市場情報公司Sensor Tower週二公布，Meta的Muse AI代理在美國上市後僅40天，下載量便突破1,000萬次。
這個速度快過OpenAI的ChatGPT及Anthropic的Claude，兩者分別花了123天及673天才達到相同的下載量。
Meta也推出了尖端級AI模型Muse Wonder及Muse Wonder Full，展現出與Google、OpenAI及Anthropic等業者競爭的能力。
此外，執行長祖克柏（Mark Zuckerberg）上個月在Meta Connect大會上發表多款新硬體產品，包括最新款Ray-Ban Meta智慧眼鏡、僅具備音訊功能的Ray-Ban Meta Audio眼鏡，以及即將推出、售價1,299美元的Meta VR眼鏡。
美銀全球研究分析師Justin Post在財報公布前的一份投資報告中寫道，「近期AI產品的推出，增強了市場對公司AI執行能力的信心。在我們追蹤的企業中，我們認為Meta的核心業務受到AI顛覆的風險最低。」
Meta股價週二下跌1.59%，至每股694.25美元。
paras_en: Yahoo Finance reports that Meta (META-US) will release its third‑quarter earnings after the U.S. market close on Wednesday, kicking off the tech giant’s earnings season.
According to Bloomberg’s analyst consensus, Meta’s Q3 earnings per share (EPS) are expected to be $3.56, with revenue of $63.3 billion, up from last year’s EPS of $1.05 and revenue of $51.2 billion.
However, capital expenditures are projected to rise 117% year‑over‑year to $41 billion, and Meta’s Reality Labs division is expected to post an operating loss of $5.2 billion.
As Meta announces its results, AI investors are expressing concern over cloud‑computing firm CoreWeave (CRWV-US)’s debt load, causing market sentiment to swing between optimism and worry.

Adding to market unease, a Gartner report released last week warned that AI infrastructure providers plan to invest more than $8.5 trillion by 2030, while combined consumer and enterprise AI revenue may only reach $3.6 trillion, potentially leaving over $4 trillion of asset value at risk of impairment through 2032.
Over the past year Meta’s stock has fallen more than 3%, partly because Wall Street wants the company to clarify how it will turn massive spending into revenue and profit.

Nevertheless, the social‑media giant has seen several recent positives. Market‑intelligence firm Sensor Tower reported on Tuesday that Meta’s Muse AI agent surpassed 10 million downloads in the U.S. within just 40 days of launch.
That rollout speed outpaced OpenAI’s ChatGPT and Anthropic’s Claude, which each took 123 days and 673 days respectively to reach the same download count.
Meta also unveiled cutting‑edge AI models, Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full, demonstrating its ability to compete with Google, OpenAI and Anthropic.

In addition, CEO Mark Zuckerberg unveiled multiple new hardware products at last month’s Meta Connect event, including the latest Ray‑Ban Meta smart glasses, the audio‑only Ray‑Ban Meta Audio glasses, and an upcoming Meta VR headset priced at $1,299.

Bank of America Global Research analyst Justin Post wrote in a pre‑earnings note, “The recent rollout of AI products has boosted market confidence in the company’s AI execution capability. Among the companies we track, we believe Meta’s core business faces the lowest risk of AI disruption.”
Meta’s stock fell 1.59% on Tuesday, closing at $694.25 per share.

items.title: 月供低至667元 中國多家銀行打響iPhone Duo搶奪大作戰
items.title_en: Monthly payments as low as 667 yuan, multiple Chinese banks launch iPhone Duo acquisition battle
paras: 蘋果(AAPL-US) 首款摺疊機iPhone Duo本月16日開啟預購，將於23日正式開售。iPhone Duo國行256GB版本起售價人民幣（下同）15,999元，頂配2TB版本售價26,499元，全線進入萬元檔位，創下蘋果機型定價新高。
面對這筆大額支出，中國多家銀行紛紛推出免息分期，爭搶優質客戶。平安銀行的優惠較為突出：用戶在蘋果直營店辦理24期免息，只要訂單在次月未發生退貨，即可領取100元還款券包，疊加2倍積分，購機成本還能進一步降低。
據《第一財經》20日報導，據蘋果官網公開訊息，本次iPhone Duo發售共有2家支付機構、16家銀行上線分期免息權益，覆蓋主流消費金融渠道。
具體來看，參與機構包括花唄、微信2家第三方支付平台，工行、農行、中行、建行、郵儲、交行6家國有大行，招商銀行、平安銀行、中信銀行、光大銀行等8家股份制銀行，以及江蘇銀行、南京銀行2家城商行。
合作機構普遍提供3期、6期、12期基礎免息方案；其中花唄僅支持12期免息，其餘17家機構均開放最長24期零利息、零手續費分期。
從分期成本看，以入門版15,999元機型測算，選擇12 期免息，每月固定月供約1,333元；選擇24期免息，月供可低至667元。
每年iPhone 新品首發，銀行上線免息分期已是常規操作。對比往年，本次 iPhone Duo的分期合作機構覆蓋面更廣。依托個人消費貸款財政貼息政策，銀行的貼息壓力得到一定緩衝：根據財政部、中國人民銀行、金融監管總局的安排，符合條件的信用卡分期可享受年化 1 個百分點貼息，單人在單家銀行年度貼息上限5,000元，政策有效期至 2026年12月31日。
不過，與市場期待相比，本輪活動的福利重心仍集中在免息本身，多數國有行、股份行僅提供基礎24期免息，少有額外大額消費券或立減補貼。
市場分析師指出，iPhone高階機型購機用戶資質較好、逾期風險偏低、分期意願強，是信用卡業務稀缺優質客群。銀行藉助新機熱點，既能啟動長期未交易睡眠卡、提升信用卡活躍度與交易規模，又能以合規的實體消費分期替代高風險現金分期，強化整體零售信貸結構。
paras_en: Apple (AAPL-US) opened pre‑orders for its first foldable iPhone Duo on the 16th of this month, with official sales starting on the 23rd. The iPhone Duo’s 256 GB model is priced at RMB 15,999, while the top‑spec 2 TB version costs RMB 26,499, placing the entire line in the ten‑thousand‑yuan price bracket and setting a new high for Apple devices.

Facing this large expense, several Chinese banks have rolled out interest‑free installment plans to compete for premium customers. Ping An Bank’s offer stands out: customers who purchase at an Apple flagship store and choose a 24‑month interest‑free plan receive a RMB 100 repayment voucher if the order is not returned the following month, plus double reward points, further lowering the effective cost of the phone.

According to a report by First Financial on the 20th, Apple’s website disclosed that the iPhone Duo launch involves two payment institutions and sixteen banks offering interest‑free installment rights, covering the main consumer‑finance channels.

The participating institutions include two third‑party payment platforms, Huabei and WeChat Pay; six state‑owned big banks—ICBC, ABC, BOC, CCB, Postal Savings Bank and Bank of Communications; eight joint‑stock banks such as China Merchants Bank, Ping An Bank, CITIC Bank and Everbright Bank; and two city‑commercial banks, Jiangsu Bank and Nanjing Bank.

The cooperating institutions generally provide basic interest‑free options for 3, 6 and 12 months; Huabei only supports a 12‑month interest‑free plan, while the other 17 institutions offer up to 24 months of zero‑interest, zero‑fee installments.

Based on the entry‑level RMB 15,999 model, a 12‑month interest‑free plan results in a fixed monthly payment of about RMB 1,333, whereas a 24‑month interest‑free plan can lower the monthly payment to as little as RMB 667.

Every year when a new iPhone is launched, banks typically roll out interest‑free installment schemes. Compared with previous years, the iPhone Duo’s installment partners have a broader coverage. Leveraging personal consumer‑loan fiscal subsidy policies, banks receive some relief on subsidy pressure: under arrangements by the Ministry of Finance, the People’s Bank of China and the Financial Regulatory Authority, eligible credit‑card installments enjoy an annual subsidy of 1 percentage point, with a per‑person, per‑bank annual subsidy cap of RMB 5,000, effective until December 31 2026.

However, compared with market expectations, the current promotion’s benefits remain focused on the interest‑free aspect itself; most state‑owned and joint‑stock banks only provide the basic 24‑month interest‑free plan, with few additional large‑value consumption vouchers or instant discounts.

Market analysts note that purchasers of high‑end iPhone models tend to have strong credit profiles, low delinquency risk, and a strong willingness to installment, making them a scarce but valuable segment for credit‑card businesses. By capitalising on the hype of the new device, banks can reactivate dormant cards, boost credit‑card activity and transaction volume, and replace high‑risk cash installments with compliant physical‑goods installments, thereby strengthening the overall retail‑loan structure.

items.title: CoreWeave股價腰斬還有壓力 匯豐看再跌37%、目標價剩39美元
items.title_en: CoreWeave Stock Halved, Still Under Pressure; HSBC Sees Further 37% Drop, Target Price at $39
paras: CoreWeave, Inc. Class A(CRWV-US) 周二（20日）收在62.13美元，較52周高點139.93美元下跌約55.6%。匯豐認為，這家AI雲端服務供應商仍有進一步下跌空間。
匯豐分析師在周一發布的報告中，維持CoreWeave「減碼」評等與39美元目標價，意味較周二收盤價仍有約37.2%的下跌空間。
匯豐未調整其非一般公認會計原則（non-GAAP）獲利預估，相關預測仍遠低於華爾街共識。
匯豐指出，相較於超大規模雲端業者，CoreWeave面臨結構性劣勢。該行預估，2027年CoreWeave每百萬瓦容量的年營收約為1,200萬美元，超大規模雲端業者則可達1,700萬至1,800萬美元。
報告指出，大型雲端業者透過獲利更豐厚的短期合約出租運算容量，同時經營具差異化的通用雲端業務，並服務眾多購買完整技術堆疊的小型客戶。
相較之下，新興雲端業者（neocloud）的營收，主要來自向大型客戶出租同質性高的GPU裸機運算資源。
今年5月至9月，新興雲端業者簽下多筆收益豐厚的短期交易。匯豐表示，CoreWeave在9月簽訂為期3至6個月的合約，每百萬瓦容量的年化營收約達4,000萬美元。
SpaceX(SPCX-US) 也與Anthropic及Alphabet(GOOGL-US) 旗下Google達成交易，估計每百萬瓦容量的年營收介於2,200萬至5,000萬美元。
不過，匯豐如今認為，這股趨勢面臨風險。大型語言模型（LLM）供應商的成長略有放緩，可能削弱對即期算力的需求。殖利率攀升與債市承壓，也可能使新興雲端業者無法在尚未確保需求前預先擴建容量，而這類容量通常正是高價短期合約的供給來源。
匯豐對CoreWeave 2028年至2030年的non-GAAP每股盈餘預估，較市場共識低50%至70%。長期而言，該行預期CoreWeave的non-GAAP營業利益率將達15%至16%，低於管理層提出的約25%目標。
由於投資人質疑CoreWeave將如何籌措AI基礎建設擴張所需資金，公司上周市值蒸發約四分之一。儘管周二盤前一度跌至58.58美元，股價當日收盤回升至62.13美元，較周一上漲約1.2%。
不過，其他分析師認為，這波賣壓已過頭。高盛周一將CoreWeave評等由「中立」調升至「買進」，但將目標價從139美元下修至106美元。分析師Gabriela Borges表示，投資人可能高估了公司未來的借款成本。
Evercore ISI則維持「優於大盤」評等及150美元目標價。資深董事總經理Amit Daryanani向CNBC表示，CoreWeave多數債務都有與MetaMETA-US) 、微軟(MSFT-US) 及OpenAI簽訂的合約作為支撐。
匯豐給出的39美元目標價，遠低於上述兩家機構。
paras_en: CoreWeave, Inc. Class A (CRWV-US) closed Tuesday (20th) at $62.13, about 55.6% down from its 52‑week high of $139.93. HSBC believes the AI cloud‑service provider still has further downside.
HSBC analysts in a Monday report kept CoreWeave at a "reduce" rating and a $39 target price, implying about 37.2% more decline from Tuesday’s close.
HSBC did not adjust its non‑GAAP earnings forecasts, which remain far below Wall Street consensus.

HSBC noted that compared with hyperscale cloud providers, CoreWeave faces structural disadvantages. The bank estimates CoreWeave’s annual revenue per megawatt of capacity will be about $12 million in 2027, versus $17‑$18 million for hyperscale providers.

The report says large cloud providers rent compute capacity through higher‑margin short‑term contracts while also running differentiated generic‑cloud businesses and serving many small customers that buy a full technology stack.
By contrast, emerging cloud providers (neocloud) generate revenue mainly by leasing homogeneous GPU bare‑metal compute resources to large customers.

From May to September this year, emerging cloud providers signed several lucrative short‑term deals. HSBC says CoreWeave signed a 3‑ to 6‑month contract in September that yields roughly $40 million of annualized revenue per megawatt of capacity.
SpaceX (SPCX-US) also struck deals with Anthropic and Google (Alphabet, GOOGL-US), estimated to generate $22‑$50 million of annual revenue per megawatt of capacity.

However, HSBC now sees risks to this trend. Growth of large‑language‑model (LLM) vendors is slowing slightly, which could weaken demand for spot compute. Rising yields and pressure in the bond market may also prevent emerging cloud providers from building capacity ahead of secured demand, and such capacity is typically the source of high‑price short‑term contracts.

HSBC’s non‑GAAP EPS forecasts for CoreWeave for 2028‑2030 are 50%‑70% lower than market consensus. Over the long term, the bank expects CoreWeave’s non‑GAAP operating margin to be 15%‑16%, below the roughly 25% target cited by management.

Because investors question how CoreWeave will fund AI infrastructure expansion, the company’s market cap evaporated about a quarter last week. Although the stock fell to $58.58 pre‑market on Tuesday, it closed at $62.13, up about 1.2% from Monday.

Other analysts think the selling pressure has been overdone. Goldman Sachs upgraded CoreWeave on Monday from “neutral” to “buy” but cut its target price from $139 to $106. Analyst Gabriela Borges said investors may be overestimating the company’s future borrowing costs.

Evercore ISI kept an “outperform” rating and a $150 target price. Senior Managing Director Amit Daryanani told CNBC that most of CoreWeave’s debt is backed by contracts with Meta (META-US), Microsoft (MSFT-US) and OpenAI.
HSBC’s $39 target price is far below those of the two institutions above.

items.title: 高通傳11月起全球裁員 加速半導體業務多元化
items.title_en: Qualcomm Announces Global Layoffs Starting in November, Accelerates Diversification of Semiconductor Business
paras: 《Benzinga》報導，半導體公司高通(Qualcomm)(QCOM-US)在年度員工績效評估後，正準備在全球範圍內裁員。在智慧型手機需求放緩之際，公司希望藉此強化績效導向的企業文化。
據《路透社》最先披露，執行長Cristiano Amon週一透過內部備忘錄告知員工這項計畫，裁員通知預計將於11月開始發出。公司尚未公布預計受影響員工人數。
截至2025年9月，高通在全球約有5.2萬名員工。Amon表示，公司將考量業務優先事項、組織需求，以及員工的技能與專業知識，以決定裁員安排。
此次組織重整之際，高通正加速拓展AI資料中心及其他非手機業務，以分散營收來源，包括汽車、物聯網（IoT）及AI相關應用。
面對智慧型手機市場持續疲弱，高通預期非手機業務營收成長率將從2026年的24%，加速至2027年的60%以上。公司也將2029會計年度的非手機業務營收目標，從220億美元上調至400億美元。
在今年7月最近一次財報電話會議中，高通指出，記憶體價格上漲及供應限制正對智慧型手機需求造成壓力。
高通預期，從第四會計季度開始，來自蘋果(AAPL-US)產品的營收將加速下滑。
公司將資料中心視為最大的成長機會，預期相關營收將於2027年達到50億美元，並於2029年達到150億美元。
高通股價技術面分析
高通目前股價較20日簡單移動平均線（SMA）的181.45美元低4%，較100日SMA的182.76美元低4.6%，但仍高於200日SMA的169.39美元約2.9%。
20日SMA目前仍高於50日SMA，呈現看漲排列。
相對強弱指標（RSI）為46.03，顯示市場動能中性。
9月出現的黃金交叉，即50日SMA向上突破200日SMA，仍支持較長期的正面走勢。不過，8月近期波段低點也提醒投資人，一旦支撐位失守，股價可能迅速出現大幅下跌。
關鍵阻力位在206美元附近，支撐位則在156美元附近。
財報與分析師展望
高通預計於11月4日公布財報。分析師預期，每股盈餘為2.16美元，低於去年同期的3美元。營收預估為101.1億美元，低於去年同期的112.7億美元。
高通目前的本益比為19.8倍。
分析師對高通股票的整體評級為持有，平均目標價為202.32美元。近期分析師評級調整如下：
TD Cowen： 買進，目標價上調至200美元（10/19）
Piper Sandler： 首次給予中立評級，目標價190美元（9/10）
RBC Capital： 與大盤表現一致，目標價上調至180美元（9/9）
paras_en: Benzinga reports that semiconductor company Qualcomm (QCOM-US) is preparing to conduct global layoffs following its annual employee performance reviews. With smartphone demand slowing, the company aims to strengthen a performance‑driven corporate culture through the cuts.

According to an initial Reuters disclosure, CEO Cristiano Amon informed staff of the plan via an internal memo on Monday, and layoff notices are expected to begin issuing in November. The company has not yet released the projected number of affected employees.

As of September 2025, Qualcomm employs roughly 52,000 people worldwide. Amon said the company will consider business priorities, organizational needs, and employees' skills and expertise when determining the layoff arrangements.

Amid this organizational restructuring, Qualcomm is accelerating the expansion of its AI data‑center and other non‑smartphone businesses to diversify revenue sources, including automotive, Internet of Things (IoT) and AI‑related applications.

Facing continued weakness in the smartphone market, Qualcomm expects the growth rate of its non‑smartphone revenue to jump from 24% in 2026 to over 60% in 2027. The company also raised its non‑smartphone revenue target for fiscal 2029 from $22 billion to $40 billion.
In the most recent earnings call in July, Qualcomm noted that rising memory prices and supply constraints are putting pressure on smartphone demand.
Qualcomm forecasts that revenue from Apple (AAPL-US) products will begin to decline more rapidly starting in the fourth fiscal quarter.
The company views data centers as its biggest growth opportunity, projecting related revenue to reach $5 billion in 2027 and $15 billion by 2029.
Qualcomm stock technical analysis

Qualcomm's current share price is about 4% below the 20‑day simple moving average (SMA) of $181.45 and 4.6% below the 100‑day SMA of $182.76, yet it remains roughly 2.9% above the 200‑day SMA of $169.39.
The 20‑day SMA is still above the 50‑day SMA, indicating a bullish alignment.
The relative strength index (RSI) stands at 46.03, suggesting neutral market momentum.

The golden cross that appeared in September—where the 50‑day SMA crossed above the 200‑day SMA—continues to support a longer‑term positive trend. However, the recent low in August also warns investors that a break of support could trigger a rapid price decline.
Key resistance is near $206, while support lies around $156.
Earnings and analyst outlook
Qualcomm is slated to release its earnings on November 4. Analysts expect earnings per share of $2.16, down from $3.00 a year ago, and revenue of $10.11 billion, below last year’s $11.27 billion.
Qualcomm's current price‑to‑earnings ratio is 19.8 times.
Analysts give Qualcomm an overall rating of Hold, with an average target price of $202.32. Recent analyst rating changes are as follows:
TD Cowen: Buy, target price raised to $200 (10/19)
Piper Sandler: First time assigning a Neutral rating, target price $190 (9/10)

items.title: 川普金主選前2周開砲：共和黨去年減稅是錯的　川普對盟友關稅戰是「災難」
items.title_en: Trump's Backer Fires Shots Two Weeks Before Election: GOP's 2023 Tax Cut Was a Mistake, Trump's Tariff War with Allies a "Disaster"
paras: 美國期中選舉倒數2周之際，城堡投資執行長Ken Griffin認為共和黨前景堪憂，並稱川普與美國盟友的爭鬥是問題的一部分。
Griffin週二(20日)在紐約舉行的「全球市場未來大會」(Future of Global Markets Conference)上說，共和黨期中大選選情艱難，川普關稅政策加劇了通膨，並擾亂了供應鏈。
他說：「我認為與加拿大、歐洲及我們的盟友之間的關稅戰簡直是場災難，川普在總統任期剛開始這麼做時我就談過這一點。坦率地說，我不願意這麼說，但我當時是對的。這助長了通膨。這肯定切斷了全球供應鏈。」
今年7月20日，美國總統川普宣布對部分加拿大進口商品加徵50%的關稅，理由是歧視美國汽車、酒類和乳製品出口。這些關稅已於8月生效。
美國9月消費者物價指數(CPI)年增3.7%，而自川普重返白宮以來，通膨幾乎抹去了一班勞工的時薪漲幅。燃料可負擔性和住房供應不足已成為共和黨在期中選舉中的痛點。
Griffin預測，共和黨幾乎肯定會失去對國會至少一院的控制權，並將期中選舉描述為對執政黨的制衡。「眾議院幾乎處於非常艱難的境地，而參議院的選情將非常膠著。」
他還指出，去年美國進一步減稅，是美國國會共和黨人和總統川普犯下的錯誤，美國政府在疫情期間花了很多錢，「我們並沒有延續減稅政策的財政空間」。美國債務已突破40兆美元。
Griffin認為，與增加支出相比，共和黨人過去兩年在減稅一事上問題更大。
他還對川普對伊朗戰爭的解釋有自己的看法，並稱川普政府對待移民的方式「可恥」。「伊朗戰爭非常不受歡迎。我認為他在解釋原因方面做得非常糟糕，我認為總統沒有以有力、有意義的方式向美國人民說明這一點。」
Griffin也指出，他認為應加強邊境安全，但對於已經在這裡的移民，應為他們提供「成為我們社會有貢獻成員的途徑，並幫助發展我們的經濟」。
paras_en: As the U.S. midterm election countdown reaches two weeks, Citadel CEO Ken Griffin says the Republican outlook looks bleak and describes Trump’s disputes with U.S. allies as part of the problem.

Griffin told the Future of Global Markets Conference in New York on Tuesday, the 20th, that the GOP’s midterm prospects are tough, that Trump’s tariff policy has worsened inflation and disrupted supply chains.

He said, “I think the tariff war with Canada, Europe and our allies is a disaster. I warned about this when Trump started his presidency. Frankly, I don’t like saying it, but I was right. It has fed inflation and definitely cut off global supply chains.”
On July 20 this year, President Trump announced a 50% tariff on certain Canadian imports, citing discrimination against U.S. auto, alcohol and dairy exports. The tariffs took effect in August.

U.S. consumer prices rose 3.7% year‑over‑year in September, and since Trump returned to the White House, inflation has almost erased wage gains for many workers. Fuel affordability and a shortage of housing have become pain points for Republicans in the midterms.

Griffin predicts the GOP will almost certainly lose control of at least one chamber of Congress and describes the midterms as a check on the party in power. “The House is in a very tough spot, and the Senate race will be extremely tight,” he said.

He also noted that last year’s further tax cuts were a mistake by Republican lawmakers and Trump, adding that the government spent heavily during the pandemic and “we have no fiscal space to keep cutting taxes.” U.S. debt has now topped $40 trillion.
Griffin argues that, compared with increased spending, the GOP’s tax‑cut agenda over the past two years is the bigger problem.

He offered his own take on Trump’s handling of the war with Iran, calling the administration’s immigration approach “shameful.” “The Iran war is very unpopular. He explained it terribly, and the president failed to communicate the reasons to the American people in a strong, meaningful way,” he said.
Griffin also said he supports stronger border security, but for migrants already here, the U.S. should provide “a path to become contributing members of our society and help grow our economy.”

items.title: AI圈最大騙局？全球大模型排行榜遭質疑 高分不等於好用
items.title_en: The Biggest AI Scam? Global Large Model Rankings Questioned – High Scores Don't Mean Practical Use
paras: 全球AI大廠競相拚跑分，但排行榜第一就代表最好用？隨著AI代理（Agent）開始執行複雜任務，評測標準不一、結果難以重現等問題逐漸浮現。開源AI平台Hugging Face高層指出，模型高分未必能反映實際工作能力，排行榜的侷限正受到關注。
開源AI平台Hugging Face首席政策官Irene Solaiman在TechCrunch Disrupt活動中指出，現有AI評測存在局限。尤其進入AI代理時代，實際表現不只取決於模型，也受到工具呼叫、執行框架及任務環境影響。
這些問題並不代表排行榜毫無價值，但若將單項測試高分直接視為模型的全部能力，恐怕難以判斷產品能否在真實環境中發揮作用。
跑分成行銷利器 高分未必能完成工作
從MMLU、GPQA到SWE-bench，各類知識、數學、程式設計與推理測試，已成為AI業者展示能力的重要工具。統一題目及評分方式，有助開發者觀察技術進步，也讓企業得以比較不同模型。
然而，測試環境與商業應用仍有落差。一款模型可能擅長解數學題，卻無法穩定完成複雜的軟體開發工作；另一款模型即使在程式設計榜單名列前茅，進入企業系統後，也可能因工具呼叫失敗、上下文管理混亂或權限限制，無法完成任務。
不同業者使用的測試設定、提示詞、推理預算與工具環境也可能不同。即使採用相同基準測試，成績未必能直接比較。當排名成為行銷依據，單一分數的侷限更容易被忽略。
同一個模型 搭配不同工具結果就不同
Solaiman提出的評測問題，主要涉及標準是否統一、透明且可重複，以及AI系統能力已超出傳統單一模型測試的範圍。
在AI代理應用中，相同底層模型搭配不同工具、提示詞策略與執行框架，可能交出明顯不同的成果。
例如，同樣要求AI修復軟體漏洞，一套系統可能只提供修改建議，另一套卻能搜尋程式碼、呼叫測試工具、修改檔案並驗證結果。若只比較程式碼生成分數，便難以完整衡量兩者的工作能力。
因此，評測重點正從模型能否回答問題，轉向整套系統能否可靠地完成任務。
AI代理好不好用 還要看成本與安全
AI代理與傳統聊天機器人的主要差別，在於不再只是回答問題，而是開始執行工作。過程可能涉及存取資料庫、瀏覽網頁、撰寫程式及呼叫外部工具，甚至連續運作數小時。
這使得任務完成率成為重要指標。產生看似正確的答案，不等於真正解決問題；面對相同任務時，能否持續交付一致成果，也關係到企業能否放心採用。
成本同樣不能忽略。即使AI代理能完成工作，若耗費大量Token，或反覆呼叫高價模型，商業價值仍可能受限。能否遵守權限界線、避免資料外洩，並在高風險操作前取得授權，也應納入能力評估。
換言之，評測不只要看模型有多聰明，還要確認系統能否把事情做完、做對，並控制成本。
企業挑模型 從看排名轉向看實效
對OpenAI、Google及Anthropic等業者而言，排行榜仍具有宣傳價值，但單靠跑分領先，未必能建立長期競爭優勢。開源模型陣營也正透過較低推理成本及靈活部署方式參與競爭。
企業採購時，模型能否串接既有系統、處理真實資料、穩定執行任務，以及符合安全與合規要求，往往比榜單上的幾分差距更重要。市場競爭也可能從通用能力比較，進一步轉向特定應用與完整系統的表現。
基準測試仍是衡量技術進步的重要工具，真正需要調整的是將單項成績等同於全部能力的評價方式。未來評測須同時涵蓋任務完成率、成本、穩定性、安全性與結果可重複性。
當AI走向商業部署，業者除了證明模型能拿高分，更須證明產品能穩定解決真實問題。
paras_en: Global AI giants are racing to post high benchmark scores, but does being first on the leaderboard mean a model is the most useful? As AI agents begin to perform complex tasks, issues such as inconsistent evaluation standards and irreproducible results are surfacing. Executives at the open‑source AI platform Hugging Face note that a high score does not necessarily reflect real‑world work capability, and the limitations of these rankings are drawing scrutiny.

Irene Solaiman, Chief Policy Officer at Hugging Face, told TechCrunch Disrupt that current AI evaluations have clear shortcomings. In the emerging era of AI agents, actual performance depends not only on the model itself but also on tool calls, execution frameworks, and the task environment.
These problems do not render rankings worthless, but treating a single high‑score test as a model’s entire ability makes it hard to judge whether a product will work in real settings.
Score‑driven marketing – high scores don’t guarantee task completion

From MMLU and GPQA to SWE‑bench, a variety of knowledge, math, coding and reasoning tests have become key tools for AI firms to showcase capability. Uniform questions and scoring methods help developers track progress and let businesses compare different models.

However, test environments differ from commercial use. A model might excel at solving math problems yet fail to reliably handle complex software development work; another model that tops coding leaderboards may stumble in enterprise systems due to tool‑call failures, context‑management issues, or permission restrictions.

Different vendors also use varying test settings, prompts, inference budgets and tool stacks. Even with the same benchmark, scores may not be directly comparable. When rankings become marketing fodder, the limits of a single number are easy to overlook.
The same model can yield different results when paired with different tools
Solaiman’s critique centers on whether standards are uniform, transparent and repeatable, and whether AI system capabilities have outgrown the scope of traditional single‑model testing.
In AI‑agent applications, the same underlying model combined with different tools, prompting strategies and execution frameworks can produce markedly different outcomes.

For example, when asked to fix a software bug, one system might only suggest a patch, while another can search the codebase, invoke testing tools, modify files and verify the fix. Comparing only code‑generation scores would miss the broader work capability.
Thus, evaluation focus is shifting from whether a model can answer a question to whether the entire system can reliably complete a task.
Is an AI agent useful? It also depends on cost and safety

The main difference between AI agents and traditional chatbots is that agents do more than answer questions – they start to perform work. This may involve accessing databases, browsing the web, writing code, calling external tools, and even running continuously for hours.

Consequently, task‑completion rate becomes a crucial metric. Generating seemingly correct answers does not equal solving the problem; the ability to consistently deliver results on the same task also determines whether enterprises can trust the technology.

Cost cannot be ignored either. Even if an AI agent completes a job, high token consumption or repeated calls to expensive models can limit commercial value. Adhering to permission boundaries, preventing data leaks, and obtaining authorization before high‑risk actions should also factor into capability assessments.
In other words, evaluations must look beyond model intelligence to confirm that the system can finish tasks correctly and control costs.
Enterprises shift from ranking‑centric to effectiveness‑centric model selection

For players like OpenAI, Google and Anthropic, rankings still have promotional value, but leading on scores alone may not secure a lasting competitive edge. Open‑source model camps are also entering the fray with lower inference costs and flexible deployment options.

When purchasing, companies care more about whether a model can integrate with existing systems, handle real data, run tasks stably, and meet security and compliance requirements than about a few points difference on a leaderboard. Market competition may evolve from comparing general capabilities to assessing performance in specific applications and complete systems.

Benchmarks remain important tools for measuring technical progress, but what needs to change is equating a single test score with overall ability. Future evaluations should cover task‑completion rates, cost, stability, safety and reproducibility of results.
As AI moves toward commercial deployment, vendors must not only prove that their models can achieve high scores, but also demonstrate that their products can consistently solve real‑world problems.

items.title: Sony出售逾400項XR專利給Meta  這對蘋果Vision Pro遊戲來說是個問題
items.title_en: Sony Sells Over 400 XR Patents to Meta, Raising Concerns for Apple Vision Pro Gaming
paras: 全球虛擬實境(VR)市場再傳震撼異動！科技媒體《AppleInsider》指出，日本科技巨擘 Sony(SONY-US)已正式將旗下多達 419 件延展實境(XR)相關專利移轉給 Meta(META-US)。隨著 Sony 旗下的 PlayStation VR2(PS VR2)裝置與控制器近來頻傳停產、市面供貨極度吃緊，這筆交易不僅引發外界對 Sony 是否將逐步淡出 VR 硬體市場的猜測，更意外對蘋果(AAPL-US)Vision Pro 的遊戲生態布局投下一枚不確定炸彈。
這起專利交易最早由韓國媒體《ZDNet Korea》披露，隨後由 VR 專業媒體《Road to VR》引述報導。雙方於 2025 年 12 月簽署專利移轉確認協議，涵蓋 180 件美國專利，以及在日本、中國、南韓、歐洲等地提出的 239 件同族專利申請，技術範圍包括 XR 應用運算處理、頭戴式顯示器設計及相關硬體。
《ZDNet Korea》10 月 5 日報導指出，當時美國專利商標局紀錄顯示，已有 43 件美國專利於今年 6 至 9 月分批登錄移轉至 Meta。Sony 與 Meta 均未公開宣布交易細節，Sony 也未說明未來 VR 硬體布局。
PS VR2 近月供貨吃緊，市場並傳出頭戴裝置與控制器已停止生產。
不過，《AppleInsider》引用的《GamesRadar+》報導明確指出，PlayStation 尚未證實 PS VR2 停產，因此仍不能據此認定 Sony 將退出 VR 硬體市場。
這項發展之所以牽動蘋果，在於 Vision Pro 已透過 visionOS 26 加入對 PS VR2 Sense 控制器的支援。
蘋果自 2025 年 11 月 11 日起，在美國官方線上商店販售控制器與充電座套裝，售價為 249.95 美元。
Vision Pro 原本以眼球追蹤與手勢操作為主要互動方式，但許多 VR 遊戲依賴手持控制器。加入 PS VR2 Sense 支援後，玩家可使用六自由度動作追蹤、手指觸碰偵測與震動功能，拓展 Vision Pro 的沉浸式遊戲體驗。
《AppleInsider》分析，這筆專利交易目前對 Vision Pro 的主要疑慮在於控制器後續供應。若 Sony 未來停止供應相關配件，現有庫存又逐步耗盡，可能增加新用戶取得控制器的難度，並為蘋果拓展 VR 遊戲帶來挑戰。
蘋果可能的因應方向包括擴大第三方 VR 控制器支援，或與其他遊戲硬體業者合作。
Vision Pro 雖已支援多款傳統遊戲手把，但對需要追蹤手部位置與動作的沉浸式遊戲而言，VR 控制器仍有其用途。
自行開發也是報導提出的可能選項。
9 月曝光的系統程式碼線索顯示，蘋果可能正在開發兩款遊戲控制器，但相關設計偏向傳統類型，尚無法確認是否將推出 Vision Pro 專用 VR 控制器。上述方向仍屬媒體分析，蘋果尚未公布相關計畫。
paras_en: The global virtual reality (VR) market is shaking again. Tech outlet AppleInsider reports that Japanese tech giant Sony (SONY-US) has officially transferred a total of 419 extended reality (XR)‑related patents to Meta (META-US). With Sony’s PlayStation VR2 (PS VR2) headset and controllers recently rumored to be discontinued and supply extremely tight, the deal has sparked speculation that Sony may be gradually exiting the VR hardware market and has unexpectedly thrown an uncertainty bomb into Apple’s (AAPL-US) Vision Pro gaming ecosystem.

The patent deal was first disclosed by South Korea’s ZDNet Korea and later cited by VR‑focused site Road to VR. The parties signed a patent‑transfer agreement in December 2025 covering 180 U.S. patents and 239 family‑patent applications filed in Japan, China, South Korea, Europe and elsewhere, spanning XR application processing, headset design and related hardware.

ZDNet Korea reported on October 5 that the U.S. Patent and Trademark Office records show 43 U.S. patents were logged for transfer to Meta in batches between June and September of this year. Neither Sony nor Meta has released details of the transaction, and Sony has not commented on its future VR hardware strategy.
PS VR2 supply has been tight in recent weeks, and market chatter suggests the headset and its controllers have already stopped production.
However, AppleInsider cites a GamesRadar+ report that PlayStation has not confirmed a PS VR2 shutdown, so it cannot yet be concluded that Sony is exiting the VR hardware market.
The development matters to Apple because Vision Pro, via visionOS 26, now supports the PS VR2 Sense controller.
Since November 11 2025, Apple has been selling a controller‑and‑charging‑dock bundle on its U.S. online store for $249.95.

Vision Pro originally relied on eye‑tracking and hand‑gesture interaction, but many VR games depend on handheld controllers. With PS VR2 Sense support, users can enjoy six‑degree‑of‑freedom motion tracking, finger‑touch detection and haptic feedback, expanding Vision Pro’s immersive gaming experience.

AppleInsider analyses that the main concern for Vision Pro from this patent deal is the future supply of the controller. If Sony stops providing the accessories and existing inventory dwindles, new users may find it harder to obtain the controller, posing a challenge for Apple’s VR gaming expansion.
Apple could respond by broadening third‑party VR controller support or partnering with other gaming‑hardware companies.
Although Vision Pro already supports several traditional gamepads, VR controllers remain important for immersive titles that require hand‑position and motion tracking.
In‑house development is another option mentioned in the report.

A September leak of system code hints that Apple may be working on two game controllers, but the designs lean toward conventional styles, and it is unclear whether a Vision Pro‑specific VR controller will be released. These ideas are still media speculation; Apple has not announced any related plans.

items.title: 電池產業變天了？寧德時代營收大增背後的獲利警訊
items.title_en: Is the Battery Industry Changing? Profit Warning Behind CATL's Revenue Surge
paras: 2026年10月21日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 全球電池產業正出現一個值得投資人關注的變化：電池需求持續成長，讓產業進入了一個顯著的量增周期，不過製造商未必能同步賺進更多利潤。
全球動力電池龍頭寧德時代CATL(300750-CN)10月20日公布第三季財報，營收年增58.58%，歸屬母公司淨利卻僅成長14.54%，不僅低於市場預期，獲利更較前一季下滑5.77%。營收正在快速增長，但是獲利卻已經領先停止增長，這反映出電池產業目前面臨的問題，已不只是需求能成長多少，而是電池價格、產品組合與政策成本，正在如何影響製造商的獲利能力。
從產業需求來看，電池市場其實仍維持強勁成長。根據中國汽車動力電池產業創新聯盟統計，2026年前三季中國動力及儲能電池合計銷量達1,681.7GWh，年增57.6%。其中，儲能電池銷量年增111.8%，動力電池銷量也成長38.2%。寧德時代前三季營收年增56.19%，與整體產業銷量增幅相近，顯示市場需求並未明顯轉弱，反而持續支撐電池製造商擴大營運規模。
然而，真正值得注意的是，寧德時代的營收成長速度越來越快，獲利成長卻越來越慢。今年第一季公司營收年增52.46%，歸母淨利年增48.55%；到了第三季，營收增幅提高至58.58%，淨利增幅卻降至14.54%，兩者差距擴大至44個百分點。更重要的是，第三季毛利率降至21.65%，較去年同期減少5.9個百分點。
如上圖所示，其實公司與市場早已預期電池產品單價將逐步下滑，因此寧德時代的經營策略，以及投資人原先的期待，都是希望透過出貨量增加、營收規模擴大，發揮規模經濟效益，進一步提升毛利率與營業利益率。
然而，實際財報公布後，獲利表現卻不如市場預期，顯示營收規模擴大帶來的成本優勢，仍不足以抵銷產品價格下滑及其他成本壓力。這也揭露了產業進入「量增週期」後最值得注意的下修風險：需求成長不代表獲利一定成長，當規模經濟帶來的效益不如預期，市場就可能開始下修企業未來的獲利預估。

優分析觀點：需求「還在」上修，供應鏈展望為何會「領先」下修？
這是因為，當產業進入大量擴產階段，新產能陸續開出，即使市場需求持續上修，供給增加的速度仍可能超過需求成長的幅度，導致市場供需結構領先惡化。摩根大通認為，2027年全球電動車及儲能電池需求仍可能高於市場預期20%至25%，但電池企業的獲利能力恐怕惡化得比預期更快。花期也持相同觀點，因此將寧德時代A股目標價由500元下調至479元，H股目標價由765港元下調至732港元。
為了讓新增產能的產能利用率夠高，廠商往往願意透過降價爭取訂單，使整個產業的產品價格與獲利率開始承壓。
因此， 當你有辦法能確認一個產業已經進入「量增週期」，就可以開始提高警覺，因為供給惡化的速度通常會比市場想得更快，很多只關注需求的投資人常常會反應太慢，直到事情發生了才驚覺不對勁，但早已來不及反應。
以寧德時代為例，它應該是全球最具有規模經濟的廠商，根據SNE Research統計，2026年前8個月全球動力電池市占率達39.4%，而上半年儲能電池市占率則為27.1%，兩大領域皆位居全球第一。
如果連全球龍頭都難以發揮預期中的規模槓桿效益，那麼產能規模更小、成本控制與議價能力較弱的二線廠商，未來恐怕將面臨更嚴峻的利潤壓縮壓力。
隨著下游整車廠同樣面臨稅負增加、出口退稅調降及貿易壁壘等壓力，未來可能要求電池供應商吸收部分成本，而電池廠為了維持利潤，也可能進一步向上游材料供應商壓價，降價的壓力預計將一路傳導至整條供應鏈。

paras_en: 2026-10-21 (You Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – The global battery industry is showing a change investors should watch: battery demand continues to grow, putting the sector into a clear volume‑expansion cycle, but manufacturers may not be able to translate that into higher profits.

CATL, the world’s leading power‑battery maker (300750‑CN), released its Q3 results on October 20. Revenue jumped 58.58% year‑over‑year, yet net profit attributable to the parent rose only 14.54%, falling short of market expectations and down 5.77% from the prior quarter. Revenue is soaring, but profit growth has already stalled, highlighting that the industry’s challenge is no longer just demand size but how battery prices, product mix and policy costs affect manufacturers’ profitability.

From the demand side, the battery market remains robust. According to the China Automotive Power‑Battery Industry Innovation Alliance, total sales of power and storage batteries in China reached 1,681.7 GWh in the first three quarters of 2026, up 57.6% year‑over‑year. Storage‑battery sales grew 111.8% and power‑battery sales rose 38.2%. CATL’s revenue for the first three quarters grew 56.19% year‑over‑year, close to the overall industry sales growth, indicating that market demand has not weakened and continues to support manufacturers’ scale expansion.

The key point is that CATL’s revenue growth is accelerating while profit growth is slowing. In Q1, revenue rose 52.46% YoY and net profit rose 48.55%; by Q3, revenue growth climbed to 58.58% but net profit growth fell to 14.54%, widening the gap by 44 percentage points. More importantly, Q3 gross margin fell to 21.65%, down 5.9 percentage points from the same period last year.

As the chart shows, both the company and the market have long expected battery unit prices to decline gradually, so CATL’s strategy and investors’ original expectations were that higher shipment volumes and larger revenue scale would generate economies of scale, further boosting gross and operating margins.

However, after the actual results were released, profit performance fell short of expectations, showing that the cost advantages from larger scale are still insufficient to offset falling product prices and other cost pressures. This reveals the key downside risk after the industry enters a “volume‑expansion” phase: demand growth does not guarantee profit growth, and if scale economies fall short, the market may start revising down future profit forecasts for companies.

You Analysis view: demand is still being revised upward, why is the supply‑chain outlook being revised downward first? When the industry moves into a massive expansion stage, new capacity comes online, and even if demand continues to be upgraded, supply can grow faster than demand, worsening the supply‑demand balance. JPMorgan believes global EV and storage‑battery demand in 2027 could still be 20%‑25% above market expectations, but battery makers’ profitability may deteriorate faster than anticipated. Huayi also shares this view, cutting CATL’s A‑share target price from ¥500 to ¥479 and its H‑share target from HK$765 to HK$732.
To keep utilization rates of new capacity high, manufacturers often lower prices to win orders, putting pressure on product prices and profit margins across the industry.

Therefore, once you can confirm an industry has entered a “volume‑expansion” cycle, you should become more alert, because supply‑side deterioration usually accelerates faster than the market expects. Investors who focus only on demand often react too late, only realizing something is wrong after the damage has already occurred.

Taking CATL as an example, it is probably the world’s most scale‑economy‑driven battery maker. According to SNE Research, CATL’s global power‑battery market share reached 39.4% in the first eight months of 2026, and its storage‑battery share was 27.1% in the first half, ranking first worldwide in both segments.

If even the global leader struggles to achieve the expected scale leverage, smaller manufacturers with less capacity, weaker cost control and bargaining power may face even harsher profit‑compression pressures in the future.

As downstream automakers also face higher taxes, reduced export rebates and trade barriers, they may ask battery suppliers to absorb part of the cost. Battery makers, in turn, could push price cuts upstream to material suppliers, transmitting price‑cut pressure throughout the entire supply chain.

items.title: 全球資金撤離AI股後到哪去了？富達：A股科技股處磨底階段　AI應用端將誕生「百倍股」
items.title_en: Where Did Global Capital Flow After Exiting AI Stocks? Fidelity: A-Share Tech Stocks Are in a Bottom‑Polishing Phase, AI Applications May Yield "Hundred‑Fold" Stocks
paras: 全球AI股近一個月遭集中拋售，地緣政治與宏觀風險升溫下，市場對OpenAI、Anthropic等模型公司估值產生質疑，A股科技股亦呈「美股映射」式劇烈波動。對此富達基金經理聶毅翔指出，A股科技股前期下跌主因交易擁擠與資金流出，基本面未明顯惡化，但短期波動加劇，左側抄底難度大，中長期仍看好AI前景，認為相比已大漲的基礎設施，應用端更可能誕生「百倍股」。
談及模型估值爭議，聶毅翔表示，牛市看天花板如市銷率，熊市看現金流。高利率環境壓制成長股，是AI標的走弱關鍵。

他並以SpaceX為例，該公司上市估值1.77兆美元但仍淨虧損，早期交易風險高，禁售期後拋壓大，大模型估值同樣難用傳統模型衡量，依賴技術革命信念。若Anthropic等年度經常性收入(ARR)保持高速成長，遠期估值可被消化，但關鍵在成長確定性與利率走向。此外，當前地緣政治摩擦與高油價推升美國升息機率，美國9月CPI年增3.7%，核心CPI升至2.6%，雙超預期，市場對Fed升息押注升溫，利率敏感型科技股承壓明顯。
聶毅翔認為，AI發展類似2000年網路泡沫後的早期階段，短期市場消化估值後，下一步重點轉向應用。相比基礎設施，應用端更可能誕生「百倍股」，但大模型公司也在向下做應用，如智能體和辦公工具，曾導致軟體股大跌。
他指出，真正有潛力的應用公司需具備兩大特徵：擁有獨有數據或場景(如醫療、法律、金融等垂直領域)，且毛利率能扛住推理成本。投資應用落地比在基建高位追高更具性價比，但需要極大確信度與耐心。
A股方面，聶毅翔指出下跌主因交易擁擠和資金流出，今年Q3財報顯示基本面依然強勁，但新增資金觀望。A股雖處於降息環境，但科技股高度映射美股利息週期和地緣情緒，波動加劇，「殺估值」持續多久難判斷，目前仍處「磨底階段」。
對於光模組等標的，聶毅翔稱產業基本面強勁，算力成長帶動光模組需求非線性上升，但殺估值過程中負面消息易被放大，例如近期某法律團隊傳出的「65%美國含量」規則導致大跌，該消息並非FCC正式討論的規則。光模組物料成本中DSP和光芯片以美系、日系為主，中國國內組裝廠滿足該比例並非難事，但下行期間市場情緒脆弱，負面情緒被擴大。
半導體方面，中國自給率上升是確定長期趨勢，設備受益於國產替代。中國企業在光模組領域具全球競爭力，資本開支拐點看台積電、艾司摩爾等上游訂單，目前訂單飽滿，說明下游需求強勁，尚未出現產能過剩。
交易策略上，聶毅翔建議右側確認優於左側抄底，左側難以精準捕捉最低點，易導致持續浮虧和贖回壓力。右側結合基本面、技術面與市場信號，在趨勢相對確定後介入，雖可能錯過底部10%-20%漲幅，但能確保買入即獲利，形成安全墊。關鍵是區分「頂部」與「早期右側」，避免在情緒狂熱時接盤。
paras_en: Global AI stocks have faced concentrated selling over the past month. Amid rising geopolitical and macro risks, the market is questioning the valuations of model companies such as OpenAI and Anthropic, and A‑share technology stocks have shown the same dramatic, "U.S.‑stock‑mirrored" volatility. Fidelity fund manager Nie Yixiang said the earlier decline in A‑share tech stocks was mainly due to crowded trading and capital outflows; fundamentals have not noticeably deteriorated, but short‑term volatility has intensified, making left‑side bottom‑fishing difficult. He remains bullish on AI in the medium to long term and believes that, compared with the already soaring infrastructure sector, the application side is more likely to produce "hundred‑fold" stocks.

Discussing the valuation debate for models, Nie Yixiang noted that in a bull market investors look at ceiling metrics like price‑to‑sales, while in a bear market they focus on cash flow. A high‑interest‑rate environment suppresses growth stocks and is a key reason for the weakness in AI targets.

He cited SpaceX as an example: the company’s market valuation at IPO was $1.77 trillion despite still posting net losses, making early‑stage trading risky and leading to heavy selling pressure after lock‑up periods. Valuations of large models are similarly hard to gauge with traditional models and rely on belief in a technological revolution. If companies like Anthropic maintain rapid growth in annual recurring revenue (ARR), their long‑term valuations could be justified, but the key factors are growth certainty and the direction of interest rates. Moreover, current geopolitical frictions and high oil prices have raised the probability of U.S. rate hikes; U.S. CPI for September rose 3.7% year‑on‑year, core CPI to 2.6%, both well above expectations, prompting the market to bet more aggressively on Fed tightening, which has put pressure on rate‑sensitive tech stocks.

Nie Yixiang believes AI development is akin to the early stage after the 2000 internet bubble: after short‑term market digestion of valuations, the focus will shift to applications. Compared with infrastructure, the application side is more likely to generate "hundred‑fold" stocks, though large‑model firms are also moving down‑the‑stack into applications such as agents and office tools, which have previously caused software stocks to tumble.

He pointed out that truly promising application companies need two key traits: exclusive data or scenarios (e.g., verticals like healthcare, legal, finance) and gross margins that can absorb inference costs. Investing in applied roll‑outs offers better risk‑adjusted returns than chasing high‑priced infrastructure stocks, but it requires strong conviction and patience.

Regarding A‑shares, Nie Yixiang said the decline was driven by crowded trading and capital outflows. Q3 earnings this year show fundamentals remain robust, yet new capital is cautious. Although A‑shares are in a rate‑cut environment, tech stocks are highly correlated with U.S. interest‑rate cycles and geopolitical sentiment, amplifying volatility. How long the "valuation‑killing" phase will last is hard to judge, and the market is still in a "bottom‑polishing" stage.

On optical‑module stocks, Nie Yixiang said the industry fundamentals are strong; growth in computing power drives a non‑linear rise in demand for optical modules. However, during the valuation‑cutting process, negative news can be amplified—for example, a recent rumor from a legal team about a "65% U.S. content" rule caused a sharp drop, even though the rule is not an official FCC proposal. The material costs for optical modules, such as DSPs and optical chips, are dominated by U.S. and Japanese suppliers; Chinese domestic assemblers can meet the required ratios, but market sentiment is fragile in downtrends, magnifying negative emotions.

In semiconductors, China’s rising self‑sufficiency rate is a clear long‑term trend, benefiting equipment as domestic substitutes grow. Chinese firms are globally competitive in optical modules, and capital‑expenditure turning points are linked to upstream orders from TSMC, ASML and others. Current orders are full, indicating strong downstream demand and no sign of overcapacity yet.

For trading strategy, Nie Yixiang recommends right‑side confirmation over left‑side bottom‑fishing. The left side is hard to pinpoint the exact low, often leading to sustained floating losses and redemption pressure. The right side combines fundamentals, technicals and market signals, entering after the trend is relatively certain. While this may miss the first 10%‑20% upside from the bottom, it ensures buying at profit and creates a safety cushion. The key is to distinguish between a "top" and an "early right side" and avoid taking positions during emotional frenzies.

items.title: 不必跟進降價促銷！愛迪達原價照賣、關稅退款助攻 獲利預測上修
items.title_en: No Need to Follow Discount Promotions! Adidas Sells at Full Price, Tariff Refund Boosts Profit Forecast Upgrade
paras: 德國運動用品製造商愛迪達(Adidas)(ADS-DE)因獲得美國關稅退款，加上熱銷服飾與運動用品得以用原價銷售，周二(20日)宣布上修全年獲利預測。
愛迪達周二在聲明中表示，第3季營業利益年增37%至10.08億歐元，創歷史新高，該季獲得約2億歐元的美國關稅退款。
愛迪達也預期全年營業利益將達25億歐元(約28億美元)，高於先前自行預估的約23億歐元，以及分析師所估的24億歐元。
愛迪達在10月29日發布完整財報前，提前公布這個好消息。該公司今年受惠於復古服飾需求，以及世界盃足球賽帶動的商機，持續推出新款商品。
挪威籍的愛迪達執行長Bjoern Gulden正試圖在Samba等復古運動鞋款帶動的多年銷售熱潮後，進一步鞏固公司的成長動能。他希望各地員工能迅速掌握流行趨勢，並依據當地市場的消費者需求採取行動，以帶動銷售。
這項策略讓愛迪達多數鞋類與服飾得以維持原價銷售，相較之下，包括產業龍頭Nike(NKE-US)在內的競爭對手，則被迫降價促銷。
根據聲明，愛迪達計劃在第4季重新投入約1億歐元，用於「提高營運槓桿效益的相關措施」。該公司維持先前公布的全年營收展望，以固定匯率計算的全年營收估成長9%至10%。
運動用品產業正面臨投資人疑慮，部分原因在於關稅影響、消費者信心低迷，市場也擔心疫情後的運動鞋銷售熱潮正在消退。
財報消息公布後，其在美國交易的ADR一度上漲3.9%，終場仍保持3.4%的漲幅。不過，愛迪達今年來截至周二正規交易時段收盤為止仍下跌6.5%。
paras_en: German sportswear manufacturer Adidas (ADS-DE) announced on Tuesday the 20th that it is raising its full‑year profit forecast, thanks to a U.S. tariff refund and strong sales of apparel and sports goods that can be sold at full price.
In a statement on Tuesday, Adidas said third‑quarter operating profit jumped 37% year‑on‑year to €1.008 billion, a record high, and the quarter included roughly €200 million of U.S. tariff refunds.
Adidas also expects full‑year operating profit to reach €2.5 billion (about $2.8 billion), above its own prior estimate of around €2.3 billion and higher than analysts’ forecast of €2.4 billion.

The company disclosed the news ahead of its full earnings release scheduled for October 29, noting that this year it has benefited from demand for retro apparel and opportunities generated by the World Cup, and it continues to launch new products.

Norwegian‑born CEO Bjoern Gulden is trying, after years of strong sales driven by retro sneaker lines such as the Samba, to further cement the company’s growth momentum. He wants employees worldwide to quickly spot trends and act according to local consumer demand to drive sales.
This strategy has allowed most of Adidas’s shoes and apparel to stay at list price, whereas rivals including industry leader Nike (NKE‑US) have been forced to cut prices and run promotions.

According to the statement, Adidas plans to reinvest about €100 million in the fourth quarter in measures aimed at improving operating leverage. The company maintains its previously announced full‑year revenue outlook, forecasting a 9%‑10% increase in revenue at constant exchange rates.
The sports‑goods sector is facing investor concerns, partly due to tariff impacts and weak consumer confidence, with the market also worried that the post‑pandemic sneaker boom may be fading.

After the earnings news, Adidas’s ADR traded on U.S. exchanges rose as much as 3.9% before closing up 3.4%. However, up to the close of regular trading on Tuesday, the stock has fallen 6.5% year‑to‑date.

items.title: AI從生成文字走向實體世界 ASI募資3.25億美元擴張關鍵基礎設施 估值達30億美元
items.title_en: AI Moves From Text Generation to the Physical World: ASI Raises $325 Million to Expand Critical Infrastructure, Valued at $3 Billion
paras:
在生成式AI吸走絕大多數創投資金的此刻,把AI用在實體世界關鍵基建的公司正以更快的速度兌現估值。

美國人工智慧新創公司ASI完成3.25億美元C輪融資，公司估值一舉升至30億美元，躋身獨角獸企業行列。這家前身為Air Space Intelligence的波士頓新創，主要開發用於空中交通、電力網路及軍事行動的AI模擬與監控系統，協助營運人員預測未來數小時、數天甚至數周可能發生的狀況，提前因應壅塞、供電需求變化及軍事後勤等複雜問題。隨著AI投資逐漸從生成文字與影像，擴展至航空、能源及國防等實體產業，ASI也成為資金積極追逐的關鍵基礎設施AI業者之一。

本輪融資由Spark Capital領投，參與投資的機構包括Citadel Securities關係企業、Meritech Capital、Craft Ventures、Energy Impact Partners及創投公司Andreessen Horowitz (a16z) 等。ASI表示，新資金將用於擴大能源、物流及軍事領域的系統部署，並強化位於波士頓的研究與工程團隊，持續提升AI模型對複雜實體系統的模擬、預測及最佳化能力。
ASI的技術與一般生成式AI有所不同。生成式AI主要根據訓練資料產生文字、影像或其他內容，ASI則透過持續模擬實體系統的運作，分析不同情境下可能出現的結果，協助人類在問題發生前採取行動。公司結合機率式預測與確定性模型，讓營運人員不只掌握最可能發生的情況，也能評估特定條件下系統可能如何變化，應用範圍涵蓋空中交通管理、電網調度、國防指揮及後勤規劃。
航空領域是ASI目前的重要業務之一。公司與美國交通部及聯邦航空總署 (FAA) 合作，運用AI系統模擬飛機航線、即時空中交通、天候變化及航空管制人力等因素，預測可能出現的航班壅塞，並提出調整航線或營運安排的方案，以降低延誤、提升航空安全與空域使用效率。
今年6月，ASI取得美國交通部與FAA總值8.75億美元、為期12年的國家空域系統現代化計畫。這項合約將協助美國更新空中交通管理系統，規模與年限均為公司重要的商業里程碑。據《彭博》報導，ASI在競標中擊敗包括Palantir Technologies (PLTR-US) 及Thales在內的較大型競爭者。ASI也因此成為2000年以來，僅有的4家獲得此類大型聯邦計畫的科技公司之一。
FAA已於上月在華盛頓杜勒斯國際機場導入ASI軟體，未來計畫逐步擴展至美國主要機場。系統可整合航班路徑、即時空中交通、天氣與管制人力等資訊，協助航空管制人員提前辨識交通瓶頸，規劃更有效率的航班運行方式。對航空業而言，若能更準確地預測空域壅塞並及早調整安排，將有助減少延誤及相關營運成本。

ASI的航空客戶還包括達美航空 (Delta Air Lines) (DAL-US)、聯合航空 (United Airlines) (UAL-US) 及阿拉斯加航空 (Alaska Air Group) (ALK-US)。公司表示，其系統已用於協調這些航空公司的營運。除了航空公司外，ASI也拓展至能源產業，與美國國家電網相關企業National Grid合作，運用AI技術進行電網規劃與營運分析。National Grid為美國東北部超過2,000萬人提供天然氣及電力服務，隨著電力需求上升、電網負載增加，業者需要更精確地預測需求變化、天候衝擊與潛在供電瓶頸，這也成為ASI進一步拓展能源市場的切入點。
國防業務則是ASI另一項重要成長來源。公司10月宣布取得美國陸軍一份為期5年、總值9,900萬美元的合約，將提供AI軟體，支援陸軍現代化指揮與控制系統，包括次世代指揮與控制計畫 (Next Generation Command and Control, NGC2)。相關技術可協助軍方整合不同來源的作戰資訊、評估行動情境並改善指揮決策。
ASI也已將系統部署至美國陸軍、空軍及美國太平洋司令部等國防單位。公司表示，其平台在美國空軍的使用持續擴大，並曾於名為「Operation Epic Fury」的軍事行動期間支援超過4,000名操作人員。相關部署凸顯AI模擬系統在軍事指揮、作戰規劃及後勤協調方面的應用潛力，但實際成效仍取決於系統可靠性、資料品質，以及人員如何將預測結果納入決策流程。
ASI創辦人暨執行長Phillip Buckendorf表示，未來經濟成長將取決於管理關鍵基礎設施的人員，是否具備預測複雜系統變化的能力。他指出，科技產業過去投入大量資金訓練AI處理文字與生成內容，ASI則聚焦於能管理及控制實體資產的AI系統，涵蓋飛機、船舶及電力網路等領域。公司希望讓關鍵系統從問題發生後才被動處理，轉向事前模擬、預測與整體協調。

ASI總部設於波士頓，並在華盛頓特區、丹佛及歐洲設有據點。公司前身Air Space Intelligence於2024年將總部從矽谷遷往波士頓，並更名為ASI。根據《Boston Business Journal》報導，公司約有220名員工，其中約80人在波士頓總部工作；其他報導則指出，公司員工分布於美國不同地區及歐洲。新一輪資金將用於擴大研究與工程團隊，並加速能源、物流及軍事環境中的產品部署。
ASI此次以30億美元估值完成融資，反映投資人對能直接應用於實體經濟的AI技術興趣升溫。相較於聊天機器人等面向一般消費者的產品，空中交通、電網及軍事系統對可靠性與預測準確度有更高要求，導入流程也通常更複雜；但一旦系統成為關鍵營運流程的一部分，便可能建立長期客戶關係與持續性合約收入。
不過，政府大型合約與高估值並不代表公司已經確保獲利。ASI仍須持續證明其系統能在高度複雜、容錯空間有限的環境中穩定運作，也必須將大型合約轉化為實際部署與持續收入。未來公司能否擴大能源及物流市場、深化國防合作，並在不同產業複製其技術模式，將是衡量這輪融資能否帶動長期成長的重要指標。
paras_en: At a time when generative AI is soaking up the bulk of venture capital, companies applying AI to critical physical‑world infrastructure are achieving valuations at an even faster pace.

Boston‑based AI startup ASI, formerly Air Space Intelligence, completed a $325 million Series C round that lifted its valuation to $3 billion, making it a unicorn. The company builds AI simulation and monitoring systems for air traffic, power grids and military operations, helping operators forecast conditions hours, days or weeks ahead and proactively address congestion, power‑demand shifts and complex logistics challenges. As AI investment expands from text and image generation into aviation, energy and defense, ASI has become a hot target for capital as a key infrastructure AI provider.

ASI’s technology differs from typical generative AI. While generative models produce text, images or other content from training data, ASI continuously simulates the operation of physical systems, analyzing possible outcomes under various scenarios so humans can act before problems arise. By blending probabilistic forecasts with deterministic models, operators not only see the most likely future but can also evaluate how systems might behave under specific conditions, covering air‑traffic management, grid dispatch, defense command and logistics planning.

Aviation is one of ASI’s core businesses. The firm works with the U.S. Department of Transportation and the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) to simulate flight routes, real‑time air traffic, weather changes and controller staffing, predicting potential flight‑path congestion and recommending route or schedule adjustments to reduce delays, improve safety and increase airspace efficiency.

In June, ASI secured a $875 million, 12‑year national airspace system modernization contract with the DOT and FAA. The deal will help modernize U.S. air‑traffic management and marks a major commercial milestone for the company. Bloomberg reported that ASI beat larger rivals such as Palantir Technologies (PLTR‑US) and Thales in the bid, making it one of only four tech firms since 2000 to win a federal project of this scale.

The FAA deployed ASI software at Washington Dulles International Airport last month and plans to roll it out across major U.S. airports. The system integrates flight paths, real‑time traffic, weather and controller staffing data to help controllers spot bottlenecks early and plan more efficient flight operations. More accurate congestion forecasts and early adjustments could cut delays and related operating costs for airlines.

ASI’s airline customers also include Delta Air Lines (DAL‑US), United Airlines (UAL‑US) and Alaska Air Group (ALK‑US). The company says its platform is already being used to coordinate these carriers’ operations. Beyond airlines, ASI is expanding into energy, partnering with National Grid, a U.S. utility serving over 20 million people in the Northeast, to apply AI to grid planning and operational analysis as demand, load and weather‑related challenges grow.

Defense is another key growth engine for ASI. In October the firm announced a five‑year, $99 million contract with the U.S. Army to provide AI software supporting modernized command‑and‑control systems, including the Next Generation Command and Control (NGC2) program. The technology helps the military fuse disparate operational data, evaluate scenarios and improve decision‑making.

ASI has also deployed its platform to U.S. Army, Air Force and U.S. Pacific Command units. The company notes that usage within the Air Force is expanding and that the system supported over 4,000 personnel during a mission called “Operation Epic Fury.” These deployments highlight AI simulation’s potential for military command, planning and logistics, though actual impact depends on system reliability, data quality and how users incorporate predictions into decisions.

Founder and CEO Phillip Buckendorf said future economic growth will hinge on whether those who manage critical infrastructure can predict complex system changes. He noted that the tech sector has poured money into training AI for text and content generation, whereas ASI focuses on AI that manages and controls physical assets such as aircraft, ships and power grids, aiming to shift from reactive problem‑solving to proactive simulation, forecasting and coordination.

ASI is headquartered in Boston with additional offices in Washington, D.C., Denver and Europe. The company, originally Air Space Intelligence, moved its headquarters from Silicon Valley to Boston in 2024 and rebranded as ASI. According to the Boston Business Journal, it employs roughly 220 people, about 80 of whom work at the Boston hub, with the rest spread across the U.S. and Europe. The new funding will expand research and engineering teams and accelerate product roll‑outs in energy, logistics and military settings.

The $3 billion valuation reflects growing investor interest in AI that can be applied directly to the real economy. Compared with consumer‑facing chatbots, air‑traffic, grid and defense systems demand higher reliability and forecast accuracy, and their adoption processes are more complex; however, once embedded in core operations, they can generate long‑term customer relationships and recurring contract revenue.

Nevertheless, large government contracts and a high valuation do not guarantee profitability. ASI must continue to prove its systems can operate stably in highly complex, low‑tolerance environments and convert big contracts into actual deployments and sustained revenue. Its ability to expand in energy and logistics, deepen defense partnerships and replicate its technology model across sectors will be key metrics for judging whether this financing round fuels long‑term growth.

items.title: Meta Q3財報考驗華爾街對AI支出的承受度
items.title_en: Meta Q3 Earnings Test Wall Street's Tolerance for AI Spending
paras: 《Yahoo Finance》報導，Meta(META-US)將於週三美股收盤後公布第三季財報，為科技巨頭的財報季揭開序幕。
根據彭博分析師共識預估，Meta第三季每股盈餘(EPS)預計為3.56美元，營收為633億美元，高於去年同期公布的每股盈餘1.05美元及營收512億美元。
然而，資本支出預計將年增117%，達410億美元。Meta旗下Reality Labs部門預計將出現52億美元的營業虧損。
Meta公布財報之際，AI投資人正對雲端運算公司CoreWeave(CRWV-US)的債務負擔感到憂慮，市場情緒在樂觀與擔心之間搖擺。
更令市場不安的是，Gartner上週發布報告指出，AI基礎設施業者預計到2030年將投入超過8.5兆美元，但消費者及企業AI營收合計可能僅達3.6兆美元。這可能導致「超過4兆美元的資產價值面臨減損風險，風險期間可能延續至2032年」。
過去一年，Meta股價下跌逾3%，原因之一是華爾街希望公司更清楚說明，如何將龐大的支出轉化為營收與獲利。
不過，這家社群媒體巨頭近幾週也傳出多項利多。市場情報公司Sensor Tower週二公布，Meta的Muse AI代理在美國上市後僅40天，下載量便突破1,000萬次。
這個速度快過OpenAI的ChatGPT及Anthropic的Claude，兩者分別花了123天及673天才達到相同的下載量。
Meta也推出了尖端級AI模型Muse Wonder及Muse Wonder Full，展現出與Google、OpenAI及Anthropic等業者競爭的能力。
此外，執行長祖克柏（Mark Zuckerberg）上個月在Meta Connect大會上發表多款新硬體產品，包括最新款Ray-Ban Meta智慧眼鏡、僅具備音訊功能的Ray-Ban Meta Audio眼鏡，以及即將推出、售價1,299美元的Meta VR眼鏡。
美銀全球研究分析師Justin Post在財報公布前的一份投資報告中寫道，「近期AI產品的推出，增強了市場對公司AI執行能力的信心。在我們追蹤的企業中，我們認為Meta的核心業務受到AI顛覆的風險最低。」
Meta股價週二下跌1.59%，至每股694.25美元。
paras_en: Yahoo Finance reports that Meta (META-US) will release its third‑quarter earnings after the U.S. market close on Wednesday, kicking off the tech giant’s earnings season.
According to Bloomberg’s analyst consensus, Meta’s Q3 earnings per share (EPS) are expected to be $3.56, with revenue of $63.3 billion, up from last year’s EPS of $1.05 and revenue of $51.2 billion.
However, capital expenditures are projected to rise 117% year‑over‑year to $41 billion, and Meta’s Reality Labs division is expected to post an operating loss of $5.2 billion.
As Meta announces its results, AI investors are expressing concern over cloud‑computing firm CoreWeave (CRWV-US)’s debt load, causing market sentiment to swing between optimism and worry.

Adding to market unease, a Gartner report released last week warned that AI infrastructure providers plan to invest more than $8.5 trillion by 2030, while combined consumer and enterprise AI revenue may only reach $3.6 trillion, potentially leaving over $4 trillion of asset value at risk of impairment through 2032.
Over the past year Meta’s stock has fallen more than 3%, partly because Wall Street wants the company to clarify how it will turn massive spending into revenue and profit.

Nevertheless, the social‑media giant has seen several recent positives. Market‑intelligence firm Sensor Tower reported on Tuesday that Meta’s Muse AI agent surpassed 10 million downloads in the U.S. within just 40 days of launch.
That rollout speed outpaced OpenAI’s ChatGPT and Anthropic’s Claude, which each took 123 days and 673 days respectively to reach the same download count.
Meta also unveiled cutting‑edge AI models, Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full, demonstrating its ability to compete with Google, OpenAI and Anthropic.

In addition, CEO Mark Zuckerberg unveiled multiple new hardware products at last month’s Meta Connect event, including the latest Ray‑Ban Meta smart glasses, the audio‑only Ray‑Ban Meta Audio glasses, and an upcoming Meta VR headset priced at $1,299.

Bank of America Global Research analyst Justin Post wrote in a pre‑earnings note, “The recent rollout of AI products has boosted market confidence in the company’s AI execution capability. Among the companies we track, we believe Meta’s core business faces the lowest risk of AI disruption.”
Meta’s stock fell 1.59% on Tuesday, closing at $694.25 per share.
